PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Every terminal in New Avalon asks you who you are, and every terminal in New Avalon is lying about why it wants to know. The Identity Reconstruction Suite is no different, except that this one is honest about one thing: it has no record of you. When the Civic Records Bureau scrubbed the name you were born with, it took your address, your credit history, your childhood and the little blue dot that used to follow you across the city's cameras. What remains is a blank file and a handful of habits you did not know you had.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 新阿瓦隆的每一台终端都会问你是谁，而每一台终端都在隐瞒它为什么想知道。身份重建套件也不例外，只不过这一台至少在一件事上很诚实：它没有关于你的任何记录。市政档案局抹去你出生时的名字时，一并带走了你的住址、信用记录、童年，以及那个曾在全城摄像头里跟着你的蓝色小点。剩下的只有一份空白档案，和一些你自己都不知道的习惯。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Suite exists to fill that file. It does not recover the past; the past is gone, and anyone who tells you otherwise is selling something. What the Suite does is ask you to choose a past that fits the habits your body still remembers, and to decide how hard the city should push back while you find out whether you chose well. These choices are real. They change what you can do in an operation, how guards read your face, how fast your hands reload, how much a stranger's kindness is worth to you, and what the people of New Avalon say when you walk into the room.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这个套件的作用就是填满那份档案。它不会找回过去；过去已经没了，谁要是说能找回来，那他一定是在向你推销什么。套件真正做的事，是请你选一段与你身体仍然记得的习惯相符的过去，并决定在你弄清自己选得对不对的这段时间里，城市该用多大的力气反击你。这些选择是真实的。它们会改变你在行动中能做什么、守卫怎样看你的脸、你的手装弹有多快、一个陌生人的善意对你有多大价值，以及你走进房间时新阿瓦隆的人会说些什么。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: This handbook is the only place those consequences are written down. The screens of the Suite are deliberately terse: a name, a picture, a paragraph of mood. They tell you what a lifepath feels like. They do not tell you what it does. That is on purpose. The Bureau's designers believed that nobody reads a manual until something has gone wrong, and that a choice made with a spreadsheet in front of you is a purchase rather than a life. We disagree with the second half of that belief and have written the manual anyway.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这份手册是这些后果被写下来的唯一地方。套件的各个画面刻意写得很简短：一个名字，一幅图，一段气氛文字。它们告诉你一条生命轨迹是什么感觉，却不告诉你它能做什么。这是故意的。档案局的设计者们相信，没人会在出事之前去读说明书，而且摆着一张表格做出的选择更像一次购买而不是一种人生。我们不同意后半句，所以还是把说明书写出来了。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You can open this document at any point during creation with the DOSSIER button, or press H, from the Dossier entry on the title screen, and later from the Journal. It is searchable: type a word, a number or the name of a lifepath into the query line (the slash key jumps straight to it) and the record returns every passage that mentions it. Any passage can be extracted into your personal notes with one press of its EXTRACT PASSAGE button, and EXTRACT ALL RESULTS keeps everything a query found. The whole dossier, only your notes, or your own character record from the save on this device can be saved as plain text and carried out of the terminal; in the Android app they open the phone's share sheet, so you can send them to Drive, Notes or mail. The game never sends anything you extract anywhere. The notes live on this device and nowhere else.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 在创建过程中的任何时候，你都可以点“档案”按钮或按 H 键打开这份文件，也可以从标题画面的“档案”条目打开，之后还可以从日志里打开。它可以检索：在查询栏里输入一个词、一个数字或某条生命轨迹的名字（按斜杠键可直接跳到查询栏），档案就会列出提到它的每一段话。任何一段话都可以按它的“摘录段落”按钮一键摘录到你的个人笔记中，“摘录全部结果”则会保留一次查询找到的所有内容。整份档案、只有你的笔记，或是这台设备存档里属于你自己的角色记录，都可以保存为纯文本带出终端；在安卓应用里，它们会打开手机的分享菜单，你可以把它们发送到云端硬盘、备忘录或邮件。游戏不会把你摘录的任何内容发送到别处。笔记只保存在这台设备上。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A word on tone. The Bureau wrote the first half of this handbook; the second half was added by operators who survived the first. Where they disagree, we have left both opinions in and tried to say which one is correct. Where a number is exact, it is exact. Where a number is rounded, the text says so. If you only read one section, read the one for the lifepath you are about to choose and then the section on attributes. If you read two, add the advice for the first hour at the end. If you read none, you will still be fine, because the game is built to be played without this document. But you asked what the choices mean, and this is where the answer is kept.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 关于语气。这份手册的前半部分由档案局撰写；后半部分是由熬过前半部分的特工们补上的。两者有分歧的地方，我们把两种意见都留了下来，并尽量说明哪一个是对的。数字是精确的就是精确的，是取整的会在文中注明。如果你只读一节，就读你即将选择的那条生命轨迹，然后读属性这一节。如果读两节，再加上结尾的新手第一小时建议。如果一节都不读，你照样能玩，因为这款游戏本来就是按不看这份文件也能玩来设计的。但你问过这些选择意味着什么，答案就保存在这里。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: HOW THE RECONSTRUCTION SUITE WORKS
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 重建套件如何运作

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Four screens, one file
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 四个画面，一份档案

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Suite is a short corridor with four doors. The first door is the lifepath: three cards, one choice. The second is appearance: a column of presets on the left, a preview in the middle and rows of arrows on the right. The third is attributes: five numbers and a handful of points to spend on them. The fourth is difficulty: a window onto the city and four buttons beneath it. Behind every door is a BACK button and a NEXT button. Nothing is saved until you walk through the last door, and nothing you do in the first three can be undone by the fourth, so you may wander back and forth as much as you like.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 套件是一条有四扇门的短走廊。第一扇门是生命轨迹：三张卡片，选一个。第二扇是外貌：左边一列预设，中间是预览，右边是成排的箭头。第三扇是属性：五个数值和几点可以分配的点数。第四扇是难度：一扇通向城市的窗，下面有四个按钮。每扇门后面都有“返回”和“下一步”按钮。走过最后一扇门之前不会保存任何东西，前三个画面里的操作也不会被第四个画面撤销，所以你可以随意来回走动。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You can move through the Suite with the mouse, with the arrow keys and Enter, with a controller, or with a finger. ESC steps back one screen, F steps forward and H opens this dossier. On a controller the confirm button selects and the back button retreats. Every row of arrows can be clicked on either side of its value, and the little grid between the arrows opens the full set of colours so you do not have to cycle through them one at a time.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你可以用鼠标、方向键加回车、手柄或手指在套件里移动。ESC 返回上一个画面，F 前进，H 打开这份档案。使用手柄时，确认键选择，返回键后退。每一行箭头都可以点击数值两侧的任一边，箭头之间的小方格会打开完整的颜色表，这样你就不必一个一个地翻。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What gets written
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 写入的内容

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: When you press BEGIN the Suite writes a single record: your lifepath, your look, your voice, your five attribute levels and your difficulty. It writes nothing else. It does not decide how the story goes, who lives, who you trust or what you remember; those things are made in play. What the record does decide is a set of numbers that the game reads at the start of every operation: how much Integrity you have, how fast you move, how loud you are, how much a medkit gives back, how long a network gives you before it finds you. The sections that follow list those numbers one at a time.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 当你按下“开始”时，套件会写入一条记录：你的生命轨迹、外貌、声音、五项属性等级和难度。仅此而已。它不会决定故事怎样发展，谁生谁死，你信任谁或记得什么；这些都是在游戏中形成的。记录决定的是游戏在每次行动开始时读取的一组数值：你有多少完整度，你跑得多快，你有多吵，医疗包能恢复多少，网络要多久才能发现你。后面的各节会逐条列出这些数值。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The record is stored with your save. If you play with an account, it travels with the save to the cloud and back. If you move to another device, the same lifepath and the same attributes come with you. Players in multiplayer sessions wear their chosen look, but the numbers of a lifepath only matter in your own story: in a shared session everyone fights with the same rules so that nobody feels outclassed by a stranger's file.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这条记录与存档一起保存。如果你使用账号，它会随存档同步到云端再回来。换到另一台设备时，同样的生命轨迹和属性也会跟着你。多人联机中的玩家会穿着自己选的外貌，但生命轨迹的数值只对你自己的故事有效：在共享的联机中，所有人使用同样的规则，这样没人会觉得被陌生人的档案压过一头。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Remaking Ghost
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 重塑幽灵

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Suite is not a one-time door. At any point in a save you can open the Journal and choose to remake your character. This takes you back through the same four screens with your current choices already filled in. Your progress is kept in full: chapter, story choices, standing with every faction, side quests, weapons, ammunition, upgrades and credits. Only the record changes. Two things are worth knowing. First, changing the lifepath resets your attributes to the new lifepath's minimums, because the minimums belong to the lifepath and not to you. Second, a Hardcore save can be remade in every way except one: it cannot be made easier. If you chose Hardcore, the difficulty row will refuse anything but Hardcore until the save ends.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 套件并不是一次性的门。在存档的任何时刻，你都可以打开日志，选择重塑角色。这会带你重新走过同样的四个画面，并已填入你当前的选择。你的进度会全部保留：章节、剧情选择、与各个势力的关系、支线任务、武器、弹药、升级和信用点。只有记录会改变。有两点值得了解。第一，更换生命轨迹会把你的属性重置为新生命轨迹的下限，因为下限属于生命轨迹而不属于你。第二，硬核存档除了一件事以外都可以重塑：它不能被改得更容易。如果你选了硬核，难度那一行就只会接受硬核，直到存档结束。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The old creator, the one with eight backgrounds that you combined two at a time, is gone. Saves made with it were converted without losing anything of value: each old background was folded into the lifepath it most resembled, and each left one point behind in the attribute it was about. A former Street Medic, for example, became a Lantern Row Kid with a point in Technical Ability. If you want to see exactly what changed, remake the character and look at the numbers in the sections below.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 旧的创建器，也就是那个有八个背景、要两两组合的创建器，已经不存在了。用它创建的存档在转换时没有损失任何有价值的东西：每个旧背景都被并入与它最相近的生命轨迹，并在它所涉及的属性里留下一点。比如过去的街头医生，现在是在技术能力上多一点的灯笼街少年。如果你想确切知道改变了什么，可以重塑角色，然后对照下面各节里的数字。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: THE THREE LIFEPATHS: AN OVERVIEW
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 三条生命轨迹：概览

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: New Avalon has more kinds of people than any list can hold, but the Bureau's own records sort the living into three broad piles, and so does the Suite. A lifepath is not a job and not a class. It is the place your body learned to be afraid in. Each of the three below has a home district, a way of earning a living, a handful of habits that never went away and a debt to the city that the city has not forgotten.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 新阿瓦隆的人种类之多，任何名单都列不完，但档案局自己的记录把活着的人分成了三大类，这个套件也是如此。生命轨迹不是职业，也不是职业分支。它是你的身体学会害怕的地方。下面三条各有一个故乡区域，一种谋生方式，一些始终没有消失的习惯，以及一笔城市至今没忘的欠账。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Lantern Row Kid is the street. You grew up in the narrow lanes under the paper lanterns, where every stranger is a favour waiting to be called in. You are the one who knows what things cost, who patched up the friend nobody else would touch, and who always has a little more in your pocket than the clerk thinks. The Helix Contractor is the corporation. You spent years inside the tower as a badge on a lanyard, invisible in the way the company liked, and you learned how security rooms think, how networks are guarded and how to look like you belong. The Glass Wastes Courier is the road. You carried cargo across the long dead stretch between the last transit stack and the first city light, on rails and on foot and sometimes on nothing at all, and you are faster and more reckless than anyone who has only ever known walls.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 灯笼街少年代表街头。你在纸灯笼下面的窄巷里长大，那里每个陌生人都是等着被兑现的人情。你是那个知道东西值多少钱的人，是替没人愿意碰的朋友包扎伤口的人，也是口袋里总比店员以为的多一点的人。螺旋外包员代表企业。你在塔里当了很多年挂着工牌的影子，以企业喜欢的那种方式隐形，学会了安保室怎么思考、网络怎么设防，以及怎么看起来像是属于那里。玻璃荒原信使代表道路。你在最后一座交通塔楼和第一盏城市灯光之间那片漫长的死地上运货，靠铁轨，靠步行，有时什么都没有，你比只知道墙壁的人更快也更鲁莽。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Every lifepath in this document is described the same way, so that you can compare them side by side. First comes who you were, which is the story the Suite will tell your friends. Then how it shaped you, which explains why the numbers are what they are. Then the numbers themselves, in full, with every multiplier written out and an example of what it feels like in an operation. Then the cost: every lifepath has a drawback, and the drawbacks are real. Then how the city treats you, which covers your starting standing with the five forces whose trust you will spend the whole story trying to keep, and finally some advice on playing the lifepath well and spending its free attribute points sensibly.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 本文件对每条生命轨迹的描述方式都相同，方便你并排比较。首先是你曾经是谁，这是套件会讲给你朋友听的故事。然后是它如何塑造了你，解释为什么数字是这样的。再然后是数字本身，全部列出，每个倍率都写明白，并配一个行动中的手感例子。接着是代价：每条生命轨迹都有缺点，而且缺点是真的。然后是城市如何对待你，包括你与五股势力的初始关系，你将用整个故事去努力保住它们的信任。最后是一些关于如何玩好这条轨迹、如何明智地分配其免费属性点的建议。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Three more things hold for all of them. Each lifepath sets minimum levels in two attributes; you can raise those attributes but never lower them, and the minimums are included in every figure quoted under "at the start" below. Each lifepath leaves you four free attribute points to place wherever you like, up to a maximum level of eight in any single attribute. And each lifepath begins your story with different standings in the city's five ledgers: Raven Trust, Voss Integrity, Civilian Hope, Corporate Leverage and AI Sympathy. These are the numbers the story reads when a character decides whether to open a door for you, so they matter even if no weapon ever fires.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 另外有三点对所有生命轨迹都成立。每条生命轨迹会在两项属性上设定下限；你可以提高这些属性，但永远不能降低，下面所有“开局时”的数字都已包含这些下限。每条生命轨迹还会留给你四个可以随意分配的免费属性点，任何一项属性最高为八级。并且，每条生命轨迹会让你的故事以不同的方式起步，也就是城市五本账簿上的初始关系：渡鸦信任、沃斯操守、平民希望、企业筹码和AI同情。当某个角色决定要不要为你开门时，故事读取的正是这些数字，所以即使从不开一枪，它们也很重要。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: If you like to choose by temperament, here is the short version. Choose the Lantern Row Kid if you want to be hard to kill slowly and expensive to ignore: you heal, you earn, you recover from mistakes. Choose the Helix Contractor if you want to avoid the fight altogether: you are seen late, you hack quickly and you pay for it in a thinner body and a louder reputation. Choose the Glass Wastes Courier if you want the fight to be about movement: you are fast, you dodge often, your hands are steady and you never learned to sneak.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 如果你喜欢凭气质来选，这里有简短版。想要难杀而又不可忽视，就选灯笼街少年：你会治疗，会赚钱，也能从失误里恢复。想要完全避开战斗，就选螺旋外包员：你被发现得晚，黑入得快，代价是更单薄的身体和更响亮的名声。想让战斗围绕移动展开，就选玻璃荒原信使：你很快，常常闪避，手很稳，而且从没学会潜行。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: LIFEPATH I · LANTERN ROW KID
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 生命轨迹一 · 灯笼街少年

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Who you were
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你曾经是谁

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Lantern Row does not appear on the Bureau's tourist maps because it is not one street. It is a knot of lanes, stairwells and covered passages tied together by strings of paper lanterns, and the lanterns are older than the towers that now loom over them. Under the lanterns, noodle bars share walls with card rooms, card rooms share walls with clinics that have no names, and the clinics share walls with the homes of the people who run all three. Nobody on the Row has a surname they use in public. Everybody has a tab.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 灯笼街不在档案局的游客地图上，因为它不是一条街。它是一团由巷子、楼梯和有顶的通道缠在一起的结，用成串的纸灯笼串起来，而灯笼比如今压在它上面的高塔还要老。灯笼下面，面馆和牌室共用一面墙，牌室和没有名字的诊所共用一面墙，诊所又和经营这三者的人的家共用一面墙。街上没有人在公开场合用姓氏。每个人都有一笔账。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You grew up in the back rooms. At eight you were carrying bowls. At eleven you were running messages between the card rooms, and learned that a message delivered fast and unread was worth more than the same message delivered slowly with a comment. At fourteen you were sitting at the foot of a folding table while someone older stitched a stranger's arm under a hanging lamp, and you were told to hold the light steady and not to ask who he was. You held the light. You did not ask. By sixteen you were the person who knew which door to knock on when something needed to be fixed, found, patched or forgotten.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你在后屋里长大。八岁时你在端碗。十一岁时你在牌室之间跑腿送信，并学到一条消息送得快又不拆封，比送得慢还加评论更值钱。十四岁时你坐在折叠桌脚边，看年长的人在吊灯下给一个陌生人缝手臂，有人叫你把灯举稳，别问他是谁。你举着灯，没有问。到十六岁，你已经是那个出了什么事需要修补、寻找、包扎或遗忘时，知道该敲哪扇门的人。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What you were, in the end, was useful. Not powerful, not rich, not feared, but useful in a thousand small ways to a thousand small people, which is the only kind of power the lower city lets anyone keep. When the Bureau scrubbed your name, the Row did not notice for a week. When it noticed, it quietly set out a bowl for you anyway.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 说到底，你曾经是有用的人。不是强大，不是富有，也不是令人畏惧，而是在一千件小事上对一千个小人物有用，这是下层城市允许任何人保留的唯一一种力量。当档案局抹掉你的名字时，灯笼街一个星期都没有察觉。察觉之后，它还是悄悄给你留了一碗面。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: How it shaped you
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 它如何塑造了你

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Row teaches three things, and they are the three things this lifepath gives you. The first is that money is a kind of attention. Every credit that passes through your hands is a person agreeing, for a moment, to pay you more heed than they pay the next fellow, and you have never been bad at making them pay. The second is that bodies are machines that complain, and that most of the people you love are one bad night from needing someone to hold the light. You learned to stay calm with your hands in other people's worst moments, and the calm never left. The third is that you are always being watched by the people who own the Row's debts. Helix has a long file on Lantern Row operators, and the file has your face in it, so when you get noticed, you get noticed hard.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 灯笼街教会你三件事，这三件事就是这条生命轨迹给你的东西。第一，钱是一种注意力。每一枚经过你手的信用点，都是有人同意暂时多看你一眼，而你一向擅长让人为此付钱。第二，身体是会抱怨的机器，你爱的大多数人离一个需要有人举灯的糟糕夜晚都只差一步。你学会了把手伸进别人最糟的时刻时仍然保持冷静，这份冷静再也没有离开过你。第三，你总是被掌握灯笼街债务的人盯着。螺旋有一份很长的、关于灯笼街经营者的档案，档案里有你的脸，所以当你被注意到的时候，你被注意得很重。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: None of this makes you a fighter. The Row prizes the person who can get a favour done without anybody swinging at anybody, and the habits it gave you reflect that: you are good at living, better at recovering and mediocre at killing. That trade-off is the spine of the lifepath.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这些都不会让你成为战士。灯笼街看重的是不用谁出手就能把事办成的人，它教给你的习惯也反映了这一点：你擅长活着，更擅长恢复，杀人则很一般。这种取舍是这条生命轨迹的脊梁。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What it does: the numbers
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 它能做什么：数字

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Credits first. Every credit you earn from takedowns, loot and gigs is multiplied by 1.30. That is thirty percent more, applied to the amount before any other bonus, and it applies to everything you can sell or take: a guard's pockets, a crate in a back room, the fee for a courier run, the payout at the end of a bounty. Over a long game, this is the single biggest effect of the lifepath. The Black Market stops being a place where you ration purchases and becomes a place where you shop.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 先说信用点。你从击倒、战利品和零工中得到的每一枚信用点都乘以 1.30。也就是多百分之三十，在其他加成之前计算，并适用于一切你能卖掉或拿走的东西：守卫的口袋，后屋里的一个箱子，一次快递跑腿的酬金，一次悬赏结束时的报酬。在一场漫长的游戏里，这是这条生命轨迹最大的单项效果。黑市不再是你需要精打细算的地方，而是一个你可以逛的地方。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Healing second, and there are three separate pieces. Medkits that you pick up in an operation restore 45 Integrity instead of the usual 35. Noah's Analogue Kit, the consumable that restores a share of your total Integrity at once, heals 70 percent of your maximum instead of 60. And you regenerate passively: once four full seconds have passed without anything damaging you, your Integrity climbs by one and a half points every second until you are hurt again or you are full. It is a slow climb, and a single stray bullet resets the clock, but between fights in a quiet room it is the difference between needing a medkit and not.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 再说治疗，分三个部分。你在行动中捡起的医疗包恢复 45 点完整度，而不是通常的 35 点。诺亚的模拟工具包，也就是一次性恢复你最大完整度一定比例的消耗品，能恢复百分之七十而不是六十。你还会被动再生：在整整四秒没有受到任何伤害后，你的完整度每秒上升一点五，直到你再次受伤或者回满。这个过程很慢，一颗流弹就会让计时重来，但在一个安静的房间里、两场战斗之间，这就是需要医疗包和不需要之间的差别。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Those are the lifepath's own numbers. The minimum attributes add to them. A Lantern Row Kid starts with Technical Ability 4 and Cool 5, and each level above 3 contributes a little: one level of Technical Ability adds two percent to your weapon damage, three Integrity to every medkit and one and a half percentage points to the Analogue Kit; two levels of Cool make guards notice you six percent more slowly, make your sneaking speed eight percent higher and make Helix Heat build eight percent more slowly. Put together, here is what you actually hold at the start of the game, before you spend a single free point: credits ×1.30, medkits restore 48 Integrity, the Analogue Kit restores 71.5 percent, passive regeneration of 1.5 per second, guards at 94 percent of their normal detection speed, sneaking speed ×1.08, weapon damage ×0.969 and Helix Heat at ×1.196 its normal rate.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这些是生命轨迹本身的数字。属性下限还会在此基础上增加。灯笼街少年开局时技术能力为 4，冷静为 5，每超过 3 的一级都会带来一点好处：一级技术能力会使你的武器伤害增加百分之二，每个医疗包多三点完整度，诺亚工具包多一点五个百分点；两级冷静使守卫发现你的速度慢百分之六，潜行速度提高百分之八，螺旋通缉的上升速度慢百分之八。综合起来，这就是你在花掉任何一个免费点之前、在游戏开始时实际拥有的东西：信用点 ×1.30，医疗包恢复 48 点完整度，模拟工具包恢复百分之七十一点五，被动再生每秒 1.5，守卫以百分之九十四的正常侦测速度发现你，潜行速度 ×1.08，武器伤害 ×0.969，螺旋通缉按正常速度的 ×1.196 上升。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What it costs
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 它的代价

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Two things, both of which show up in the sums above. Your weapons hit five percent softer than other people's. The Row did not teach you to shoot, only to shoot when it could not be avoided, and the Suite remembers: every weapon you carry deals ninety-five percent of its listed damage, before upgrades and attribute bonuses. Over a long game with an unfavourable matchup, this is the difference between two shots and three.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 两样东西，两者都体现在上面的计算里。你的武器比别人的轻百分之五。灯笼街没有教你射击，只教你在不得不开枪时开枪，而套件记得这一点：你携带的每把武器都只造成标注伤害的百分之九十五，这是在升级和属性加成之前。在一场漫长而不利的对局里，这就是两枪和三枪的差别。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: And Helix Heat builds thirty percent faster. Heat is the city's measure of how loudly you have broken things, from one diamond to five; a higher rate means the Civic Response squads arrive sooner after you are noticed, and stay longer. Because the Row is on Helix's old files, the rate is high from the start and your Cool attribute only partly pays it back. Plan around it: if you intend to make noise, make it fast and leave.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 还有，螺旋通缉上升得快百分之三十。通缉是城市衡量你破坏得有多响的尺度，从一颗菱形到五颗；速率越高，市政响应小队在你被发现之后到达得越快，也停留得越久。因为灯笼街在螺旋的旧档案里，所以速率从一开始就高，而你的冷静属性只能偿还其中一部分。要围绕它做计划：如果你打算制造噪音，就要快，而且要走。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: How the city treats you
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 城市如何对待你

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You start with Civilian Hope +4 and Corporate Leverage −3. Hope is the ledger the story reads when ordinary people decide whether you are one of them. At the start of the story you are already three notches ahead of the other lifepaths, and the vendors, the night workers and the medics will say so in the dialogue they give you. Corporate Leverage is the opposite: it is how much a corporation is willing to bend for you, and you start with less than anyone. Corporate characters will be cooler and shorter with you, and a few doors that open easily to a Helix Contractor will stay closed to you until you have earned them another way.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你开局时有平民希望 +4 和企业筹码 −3。希望是故事在普通人判断你是不是自己人时读取的那本账。故事开始时，你已经比其他生命轨迹领先三格，小贩、夜班工人和医生都会在给你的对话里表现出来。企业筹码则相反：它是企业愿意为你让步的程度，你开局时比任何人都少。企业角色对你会更冷淡、更简短，有几扇对螺旋外包员轻松打开的门，在你用别的方式挣到之前会一直关着。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Raven, Voss and the machines are neutral on you at the start. That is good news in its way: nobody has a prior opinion, and the story is free to give you whichever one you earn.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 渡鸦、沃斯和机器在开局时对你保持中立。从某种意义上说这是好消息：没有人对你有先入之见，故事可以自由地给你任何你赢得的东西。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Playing it well
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 如何玩好

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A Lantern Row Kid wins by not losing. Take every medkit, and use them early rather than hoarding them, because the regeneration will top you up afterwards. Fight from cover, retreat to cool down and let the clock run down before you step back out. Because your damage is a little low, pick up weapons that reward patience and accuracy, and consider the quieter options: a takedown from behind pays the same credits as a firefight and costs nothing. Keep the Black Market in mind. Thirty percent more credits means the better weapons and the ammunition conversions come sooner, so shop early and shop often.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 灯笼街少年靠不输而赢。捡起每一个医疗包，并且早用而不要囤着，因为再生之后会把你补满。依靠掩体战斗，撤退去冷却，等计时走完再走出来。因为你的伤害有点低，就选那些奖励耐心与精准的武器，也考虑更安静的选择：从背后的一次击倒与一场枪战给出同样的信用点，却什么都不花。记住黑市。多百分之三十的信用点意味着更好的武器和弹药转换来得更早，所以早买，常买。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: For your four free attribute points, the sensible choices are Body and Reflexes. Body makes your regeneration go further, because there is more Integrity to refill and less of it is lost in each hit. Reflexes cover the thing the lifepath does worst: movement and recoil. If you would rather lean into the lifepath, put two more levels in Cool and two in Technical Ability, and you will be a stealthier, tougher, richer version of what you already are. If you would rather push against it, put them all into Reflexes and learn to fight.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 对于你的四个免费属性点，明智的选择是体质和反应。体质让你的再生走得更远，因为有更多的完整度要补，每次受击损失也更少。反应则弥补这条轨迹最弱的地方：移动和后坐力。如果你想顺着这条轨迹走，就再往冷静里投两级，往技术能力里投两级，你会成为一个更隐蔽、更耐打、更有钱的自己。如果你想逆着它走，就全部投进反应，学着战斗。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: LIFEPATH II · HELIX CONTRACTOR
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 生命轨迹二 · 螺旋外包员

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Helix does not employ most of the people who work for it. It contracts them: through agencies, through agencies' agencies, through three layers of consultancies whose only function is to make sure that the person carrying the coffee has never signed anything with the company that owns the coffee. You were one of those people. Your lanyard was a different colour from the staff's, your elevators were the service ones, and your name appeared on no directory, which was convenient for everybody and made you, in a way nobody had planned, nearly invisible.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 螺旋雇用的人其实并不多。它把大多数人外包出去：通过中介，通过中介的中介，通过三层咨询公司，这些公司唯一的作用，是确保端咖啡的人从未和拥有这杯咖啡的公司签过任何东西。你就是其中之一。你的工牌颜色和正式员工不同，你坐的是服务电梯，你的名字不出现在任何名录上，这对谁都方便，也让你以一种谁都没有计划过的方式几乎隐形。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You spent years inside the tower anyway. You learned the rhythm of the place: the cascade of catered stand-ups at nine, the mandatory optimism seminars at eleven, the long grey hour after lunch when the security desks thinned and the badge readers were most likely to forgive a stranger. You learned where the cameras overlapped and where, by the tired logic of facilities management, they did not. You learned the seventeen different ways a Helix employee says "I think you're in the wrong meeting" and the single posture that makes them stop saying it. You learned that there is a floor between eighty-seven and eighty-eight that the lift announces and the plans deny, and that the polite thing to do about it is nothing.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 不过你还是在塔里待了很多年。你摸清了这个地方的节奏：九点一连串的茶歇早会，十一点的强制乐观研讨，午饭后那段漫长的灰色时光，那时安保台前人变少，刷卡机最容易放过陌生人。你知道摄像头在哪里重叠，又在哪里因为设施管理那种疲惫的逻辑而没有重叠。你听过螺旋员工说“我觉得你走错会议室了”的十七种说法，也知道让他们不再这样说的那种唯一的站姿。你还知道八十七层和八十八层之间有一层，电梯会报，图纸却否认，而对此礼貌的做法是什么都不做。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Then one night the file closed. It was a clean erasure: no flash, no sirens, only an automated message to a mailbox you no longer had. The company that never knew your name has not forgotten your face, and it is the face, not the name, that the cameras remember.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 然后有一天夜里，档案关闭了。那是一次干净的抹除：没有闪光，没有警报，只有一条发给你已不再拥有的邮箱的自动消息。那家从没知道你名字的公司并没有忘记你的脸，而摄像头记得的是脸，不是名字。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The tower teaches a way of standing. You walk like someone who is already late for something important and does not want to be stopped. You carry a tablet whether or not it is switched on. You look at security the way a stranger looks at a menu, as if you are only waiting for the right option to catch your eye. Guards read you as part of the furniture of authority, and for a few seconds longer than they should, they do not decide what you are.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 塔教给你一种站姿。你走起路来像一个已经迟到、又不想被拦住的重要人物。你总是拿着平板，不管它有没有开机。你看安保就像陌生人看菜单，仿佛只是在等合适的选项抓住你的目光。守卫把你当作权威家具的一部分，在比他们应该用的时间稍长的几秒钟里，他们没有判断你是什么。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: It also teaches how the machines are meant to be used. Corporate networks are built by people who assume that anyone who gets in has already been vetted, and you watched those people vet each other every morning. You have seen the diagrams. You know where the seams are because you have eaten lunch next to the engineers who put them there. Hacking, for you, is not an act of violence. It is a conversation with a system that has already decided to let you speak.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 塔也教给你机器该怎样被使用。企业网络由一群假定任何进入的人都已经被审查过的人建造，而你每天早晨都看着这些人互相审查。你见过那些图。你知道接缝在哪里，因为你曾和安装接缝的工程师并肩吃过午饭。对你来说，黑入不是暴力行为。它是和一个已经决定让你开口的系统的谈话。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The price of all that polish is that you never had to be tough. Helix keeps its contractors comfortable, which means that you are somewhat softer than people who learned to take hits in lanes and alleys and on the long roads, and Helix keeps their faces, which means that when you stop being polite, the whole company hears.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这一切光鲜的代价是你从未需要变得强硬。螺旋让它的外包员过得舒服，这意味着你比那些在巷子里、小路上、漫长公路上学会挨打的人要软一些；螺旋也留着他们的脸，这意味着当你不再礼貌的时候，整家公司都听得到。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Start with the thing Helix taught you best. Guards notice you at 65 percent of the normal rate. Every enemy in the game has a detection meter that fills while you are in their sight; a Helix Contractor's meter fills at roughly two thirds of the usual speed, so you can stand in a doorway, cross a lit room or wait beside a camera for noticeably longer before anyone raises an alarm. This is not invisibility. It is time, and in a stealth operation time is the only currency that matters.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 先从螺旋教得最好的东西说起。守卫以正常速度的百分之六十五注意到你。游戏里每个敌人都有一个侦测条，在你处于其视线内时会填充；螺旋外包员的侦测条大约以平常三分之二的速度填充，所以你可以在门口站立、穿过一间亮着灯的房间，或者在摄像头旁边等待，明显更久，才会有人拉响警报。这不是隐形。这是时间，而在潜行行动里，时间是唯一重要的货币。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Second, hacking. Every terminal you break into requires a sequence of codes, normally three; you need two. The sequence is one code shorter, which is a third less work and a third less exposure while the trace is running. If you have ever failed an ICE BREAK because the network found you halfway through, this is the lifepath that makes that happen less. The trace itself, the countdown that tells you how long you have before the network finds you, also lasts 25 percent longer. Your EMP pulse is cheaper: it costs 40 Energy instead of 55, so you can fire one and still have enough left to dash out of trouble. And every credit you earn is worth ten percent more, because you know what a cheque looks like.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 第二是黑入。你闯入的每个终端都需要一串代码序列，通常是三个；你只需要两个。序列短了一个代码，这意味着少三分之一的工作量，在追踪进行的时候少三分之一的暴露。如果你曾因为网络在半途发现你而破冰入侵失败，这条生命轨迹会让这种情况少一些。追踪本身，也就是告诉你网络还要多久发现你的倒计时，也会延长百分之二十五。你的电磁脉冲更便宜：它消耗 40 点能量而不是 55，所以你发完一次脉冲之后仍然有足够的能量冲刺脱身。你赚到的每一枚信用点也多值百分之十，因为你知道支票长什么样。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The minimum attributes add to this. A Helix Contractor starts with Intelligence 5 and Cool 4. Two levels of Intelligence take another six Energy off the EMP pulse, add twelve percent to the trace and add six to your maximum Energy. One level of Cool makes guards notice you three percent more slowly, makes you sneak four percent faster and makes Helix Heat build four percent more slowly. Put together, here is what you actually hold at the start: guards notice you at 63 percent of their normal speed, ICE sequences are one code shorter, the EMP pulse costs 34 Energy, the ICE trace lasts 40 percent longer, credits are ×1.10, your maximum Energy is 106, sneaking speed is ×1.04 and Helix Heat builds at ×1.2.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 属性下限会在此基础上再加成。螺旋外包员开局时智力为 5，冷静为 4。两级智力会让电磁脉冲再少耗六点能量，追踪再长百分之十二，最大能量增加六点。一级冷静使守卫发现你的速度慢百分之三，潜行快百分之四，螺旋通缉的上升慢百分之四。综合起来，这就是你开局时实际拥有的东西：守卫以正常速度的百分之六十三发现你，破冰序列短一个代码，电磁脉冲消耗 34 点能量，破冰追踪延长百分之四十，信用点 ×1.10，最大能量 106，潜行速度 ×1.04，螺旋通缉按 ×1.2 的速度上升。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You are softer. Your maximum Integrity is ten points lower than anyone else's: 90 instead of 100 at the start of the game, before any paper stars or Black Market upgrades. It does not sound like much, and in a firefight it is a stray bullet and a half, but it means that mistakes cost more than they would cost a Nomad or a Kid, and a Contractor who is spotted in the open has to leave rather than fight.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你更软。你的最大完整度比其他人低十点：游戏开始时是 90 而不是 100，这还在任何纸星星或黑市升级之前。听起来不多，在一场枪战里大约是一颗半流弹，但这意味着你犯的错比信使或少年付出的更多，而在空旷地带被发现的外包员必须离开而不是战斗。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: And Helix Heat builds twenty-five percent faster. At the start, with the minimum Cool already counted, the rate is 1.2 times normal. The company has your face on file. The cameras recognise you without being told to, the Civic Response squads are quicker to take an interest and every escalation climbs faster than it would for a stranger. This is the reason a Contractor needs to be careful: your stealth is genuinely better than other people's, but your failure is genuinely worse.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 还有，螺旋通缉上升得快百分之二十五。开局时，已经计入冷静下限的速率是正常的 1.2 倍。公司有你脸的档案。摄像头不用人告诉就认得你，市政响应小队更快对你产生兴趣，每一次升级都比陌生人升得更快。这就是外包员必须小心的原因：你的潜行确实比别人好，但你的失败也确实比别人糟。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You start with Corporate Leverage +5, Raven Trust −3 and AI Sympathy +2. The first is the biggest swing in the Suite: Corporate Leverage is how far a corporate character will bend, and starting with 55 instead of 50 puts you among the few people in the lower city for whom a Helix door will occasionally open from the inside. The second is the price. Raven, who runs with the people the company squeezes, takes one look at your lanyard-shaped posture and starts the story three notches cooler, and you will spend the early chapters earning back the trust that the Street and the Road were handed for free. The third comes from the networks themselves: the machines you work beside do not judge you for what you were, and a small AI sympathy is the reward.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你开局时有企业筹码 +5、渡鸦信任 −3 和AI同情 +2。第一个是套件里最大的一次摆动：企业筹码是企业角色愿意让步的程度，从 55 而不是 50 起步，意味着你是下层城市里少数几个偶尔能让螺旋的门从里面为你打开的人之一。第二个是代价。渡鸦与被公司压榨的人为伍，一眼就看出你工牌形状的站姿，故事开始时就冷了三格，你将用早期章节去赢回街头和道路被白白赠予的信任。第三个来自网络本身：你身边工作的机器不会因你曾经是什么而评判你，一点AI同情是它们给的回报。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Civilian Hope and Voss Integrity start untouched.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 平民希望和沃斯操守保持不变。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A Helix Contractor wins by arriving unnoticed. Move at walking pace, use doorways, let your detection meter rise slowly to the edge and then back off. Pick weapons with silencers and use the takedown whenever you can reach it; you do not need to fight, and you cannot afford to. Hack everything in sight. Terminals are quicker for you, the trace gives you more room, and the EMP is cheap enough to use as an emergency brake: one press stuns everyone within ten metres for several seconds, which is usually long enough to walk away from a mistake.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 螺旋外包员靠不被察觉地抵达而赢。以步行的速度移动，利用门洞，让你的侦测条缓缓升到边缘再退回去。选择带消音器的武器，只要够得着就使用击倒；你不需要战斗，也承担不起战斗。能黑的都黑掉。终端对你更快，追踪给你更多空间，电磁脉冲也便宜到可以当紧急刹车：一次按键就让十米内所有人晕眩数秒，这通常足够你从一个错误里走开。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Spend your four free points where the lifepath is thin. Body is the obvious answer: each level above 3 adds seven to your maximum Integrity, so three levels of Body will repay the ten you gave up and put you ahead of where you started. Reflexes help with the other weakness, the time between being seen and being gone. If you would rather lean into the lifepath, a sixth level of Intelligence adds an extra code to the ICE buffer, and a seventh shortens every sequence by one more code; with those, an ICE BREAK becomes a short, comfortable formality.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 把你的四个免费点花在这条轨迹薄弱的地方。体质是显而易见的答案：每超过 3 的一级增加七点最大完整度，所以三级体质就能补回你让出的十点并且让你更靠前。反应能帮助另一个弱点，也就是被看到与离开之间的时间。如果你更想顺着这条轨迹走，第六级智力会给破冰缓冲区再加一个代码，第七级会让每个序列再短一个代码；有了这些，破冰入侵就变成了一个短暂、轻松的形式。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: LIFEPATH III · GLASS WASTES COURIER
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 生命轨迹三 · 玻璃荒原信使

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Past the last transit stack, the city simply stops. There is no wall, no checkpoint and no sign; there is a final ring of dark towers, and then a flat grey plain stretching to the horizon, and the plain is made of glass. It is not a metaphor. Something happened in the old war, and the sand fused, and the wind that crosses it picks up signals nobody owns: dead radio, ghost transmissions, drifting fragments of other people's messages. The people of the Wastes call it the Glass, and they call themselves nothing at all, because anyone who needs a name is someone who expects to be found.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 越过最后一座交通塔楼，城市就这样戛然而止。没有围墙，没有检查站，也没有标志；只有最后一圈黑暗的高塔，然后是一片延伸到地平线的灰色平原，平原是玻璃做的。这不是比喻。旧战争里发生了什么，沙子熔化了，而掠过它的风会拾起无人拥有的信号：死去的无线电，幽灵般的传输，漂流的别人的消息碎片。荒原的人称它为玻璃，称自己什么都不是，因为需要名字的人是预期会被找到的人。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You rode freight rails through it. You rode the night trains that crossed between the Railhold depots and the city's outer ring, in the gaps between scheduled services, where the cargo was never listed and the crew never asked. You rode in the back of vans with the lights off. You rode on foot when the trains stopped and the vans broke down, crossing twenty kilometres of fused sand with a pack on your back and a glass-cutter's knife in your boot. What you carried varied; why you carried it never mattered. All that mattered was that it arrived.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你曾乘货运铁轨穿越它。你乘过夜间的列车，在铁路要塞货场与城市外环之间，在正式班次之间的空隙里穿行，那里的货物从不登记，乘务员从不过问。你坐在熄着灯的货车后厢里。当列车停下、货车抛锚时，你就步行，背着背包，靴子里插着一把切玻璃的刀，穿过二十公里熔融的沙地。你运的东西各不相同；为什么运从来不重要。重要的只是它送到了。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The people who hired you valued three things: that you were quick, that you were quiet about where you had been and that you never opened the box. The Bureau's file on you lists a single employer, a dispatch office that does not exist, and a record of deliveries that stops on the night you were erased. Nobody in the Wastes has asked where you went. In the Wastes, going is what people do.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 雇你的人看重三件事：你快，你对去过哪里守口如瓶，你从不开箱。档案局关于你的卷宗只列出一个雇主，一个不存在的调度室，以及一份在你被抹除那晚停止的送货记录。荒原上没人问过你去了哪里。在荒原，离开是人们常做的事。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Roads teach urgency. You do not spend time deciding; you spend time moving. You read the gap before it opens and commit to the line, because the one lesson the Glass has for everybody is that hesitation kills, and the body that learns it does not forget. You move quickly on foot, you recover from a dodge faster than most people can finish a thought, and your hands, used to holding a cargo strap through a long hard bend, stay steady when you fire.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 道路教会你紧迫。你不花时间犹豫；你花时间移动。你在缺口打开之前就读懂它，并且坚决选定路线，因为玻璃给所有人的唯一教训就是犹豫会死，学会了这一点的身体不会忘记。你在地面上移动得很快，你从闪避中恢复的速度比大多数人把一个念头想完还快，而你的双手，习惯于在漫长的急弯里握住货物绑带，开火时依然稳定。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Roads also teach you to travel light. You never carried armour because armour is weight and weight is fuel, and the habit has not left you. You are quicker than anyone you will meet in the city and you take more from every hit, which is the whole logic of a courier in one line.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 道路还教你轻装前行。你从不带护甲，因为护甲是重量，重量是燃料，这个习惯没有离开过你。你比在城里遇到的任何人都更快，也在每次被击中时承受更多，这就是一个信使的全部逻辑。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: And roads teach you that being quiet is not the same as being slow. You were never trained to creep; you were trained to disappear by outrunning whoever was looking. The Suite will tell you the truth, which is that you are a poor sneak. You are a very good runner.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 道路还教给你，安静不等于慢。你从没学过蹑手蹑脚；你学的是靠跑得比寻找你的人更快来消失。套件会告诉你真相，那就是你是个差劲的潜行者。你是个非常好的奔跑者。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Movement first. You walk and run ten percent faster than the standard speed. Your dash, the burst of speed on the Space key, recharges in three quarters of the normal time, 0.6 seconds instead of 0.8, so you can chain dashes where others have to wait. Each dash costs 17 Energy rather than 22, which is more than a fifth cheaper, and your maximum Energy is twenty points higher. The combination is hard to appreciate until you play it: a Courier can dash, fire, dash again and still have enough left over for an EMP pulse, where a stranger would be standing at an empty meter and a locked door.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 先说移动。你走路和奔跑比标准速度快百分之十。你的冲刺，也就是空格键上的那一下爆发，恢复时间是正常的四分之三，0.6 秒而不是 0.8 秒，所以你能连续冲刺，而别人必须等待。每次冲刺消耗 17 点能量而不是 22 点，便宜了五分之一还多，你的最大能量也高出二十点。这个组合要玩过才会体会：信使可以冲刺、开火、再冲刺，仍然剩下足够用一次电磁脉冲的能量，而陌生人会站在一个空空的能量条和一扇锁着的门前。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Then the gun hand. Recoil affects you ten percent less than normal, and you reload five percent faster. These sound small, and they are small, but both are multiplied by the Reflexes bonuses, which for a Courier start well above the baseline.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 再说持枪的手。后坐力对你的影响比正常少百分之十，换弹快百分之五。这听起来不大，也确实不大，但两者都会与反应加成相乘，而对信使来说，反应加成一开始就远高于基线。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The minimum attributes are where the lifepath gains most. A Glass Wastes Courier starts with Reflexes 5 and Body 4. Two levels of Reflexes cut dash recharge by a further eight percent, recoil by eight percent and reload time by six percent, and add two percent to your movement speed. One level of Body adds seven to your maximum Integrity and reduces the damage you take by two percent. Put together, here is what you actually hold at the start: movement speed ×1.122, a dash recharge of about 0.55 seconds, a dash cost of 17 Energy, maximum Energy 120, recoil ×0.828, reload time ×0.893, maximum Integrity 107, sneaking speed ×0.8 and damage taken ×1.078.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 属性下限才是这条轨迹获益最多的地方。玻璃荒原信使开局时反应为 5，体质为 4。两级反应会让冲刺恢复再快百分之八，后坐力再减百分之八，换弹时间再短百分之六，并增加百分之二的移动速度。一级体质增加七点最大完整度，并使你受到的伤害减少百分之二。综合起来，这就是你开局时实际拥有的东西：移动速度 ×1.122，冲刺恢复约 0.55 秒，冲刺消耗 17 点能量，最大能量 120，后坐力 ×0.828，换弹时间 ×0.893，最大完整度 107，潜行速度 ×0.8，受到伤害 ×1.078。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The last two figures in that list are the price. Sneaking speed is twenty percent lower than anyone else's. In an operation where the stealth route runs along a narrow corridor, you will take longer to cover it, and the longer a patrol has to find you, the likelier it is that one will. A Courier's answer is not to fix the sneak but to avoid it: move at full speed, break the sight line and treat every corridor as a place to run through rather than to hide in.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 那张清单里的最后两项就是代价。你的潜行速度比别人低百分之二十。在潜行路线要穿过一条狭窄走廊的行动里，你会花更长时间走完，而巡逻队有越多时间发现你，就越可能发现。信使的办法不是修好潜行，而是避开它：全速移动，打断视线，把每条走廊当成要跑过去的地方，而不是躲藏的地方。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: And you take more damage. A raw ten percent more from every hit, reduced to about 7.8 percent by the Body minimum, because you carry no armour and have no reason to. It adds up: a heavy rifle that would take five hits from a Contractor takes four hits from you. This is the other reason you have to move. The only defence you carry is not being where the bullets are.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你还会受到更多伤害。每次被击中都多百分之十，体质下限把它降到大约百分之七点八，因为你不带护甲，也没有理由带。积少成多：一把重型步枪需要五发打倒一个外包员，却四发就能打倒你。这是你必须移动的另一个原因。你携带的唯一防御就是不在子弹所在的地方。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You start with Raven Trust +3 and Civilian Hope +2. Raven runs with drivers and runners, the kind of people who owe their lives to somebody who got there fast, and recognises a courier by the way they stand. You begin with warmth you did not earn, which is the warmest start the Suite offers. Ordinary people, the dock workers, the night-shift clerks and the stallholders, meet you with a small nod for the same reason: everyone in New Avalon has been saved, once, by a package that arrived on time.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你开局时有渡鸦信任 +3 和平民希望 +2。渡鸦与司机和跑腿的人为伍，那些人欠别人一条命，因为有人及时赶到，渡鸦从站姿就认得出信使。你一开始就带着一份没赚来的温暖，这是套件能提供的最暖的起点。普通人，码头工人，夜班职员和摊贩，也出于同样的原因对你微微点头：新阿瓦隆的每个人都曾被一个准时送到的包裹救过一次。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Corporate Leverage, Voss Integrity and AI Sympathy start at the usual level. Helix has never heard of you, which is its own kind of luxury: the cameras do not know your face and Civic Response does not know your name.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 企业筹码、沃斯操守和AI同情保持通常水平。螺旋从没听说过你，这本身就是一种奢侈：摄像头不认识你的脸，市政响应也不知道你的名字。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A Courier wins by tempo. Never stand still. Dash into cover, fire three rounds, dash out, reload while moving, re-enter from the other side. Pick weapons with high rates of fire, because your recoil and reload bonuses give you more of them, and pick shotguns and short-range tools, because your dash gets you in close and your Integrity gets you through it. Use the open: wide plazas, long streets and rooftops are your ground. Treat tight stealth corridors as a last resort, and where you have to take them, take them with the takedown rather than the long creep.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 信使靠节奏而赢。永远别站着不动。冲刺进掩体，打三发，冲刺出来，边走边换弹，从另一侧重新切入。选择射速高的武器，因为你的后坐力和换弹加成会让你得到更多；也选择霰弹枪和近程工具，因为冲刺带你贴近，完整度让你撑过去。利用开阔地：宽阔的广场、长街和屋顶是你的地盘。把狭窄的潜行走廊当作最后手段，不得不走时，用击倒而不是长时间蹑行。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: For your free attribute points, the lifepath asks for Cool. Each level of Cool makes guards notice you three percent more slowly, adds four percent to your sneak and shaves four percent off Helix Heat, which compensates directly for the lifepath's weakest area. If you would rather fix the body, Body is the other good choice: each level above 3 adds seven Integrity and cuts damage by another two percent. If you would rather lean into the lifepath, put everything into Reflexes. At level 8 you will dash on a cooldown of about half a second, hold a sight picture through a rotary gun, and reload as fast as anyone alive.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 对于你的免费属性点，这条轨迹要的是冷静。每一级冷静使守卫发现你慢百分之三，潜行快百分之四，并让螺旋通缉少涨百分之四，这直接弥补了这条轨迹最弱的方面。如果你更想补身体，体质是另一个好选择：每超过 3 的一级增加七点完整度，再减少百分之二伤害。如果你更想顺着这条轨迹走，就全部投进反应。到八级时，你的冲刺冷却大约只有半秒，能在转管机枪前保持瞄准，并且换弹速度无人能及。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: ATTRIBUTES
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 属性

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: How points work
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 点数如何运作

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Five attributes describe what you trained, as opposed to who you were: Body, Reflexes, Intelligence, Technical Ability and Cool. Each starts at 3, the level of an ordinary healthy adult who has never been asked to do anything difficult. Your lifepath raises two of them to a minimum, and those minimums cannot be lowered; the Suite marks them MIN LEVEL as a reminder. You then have four free points to spend in any combination, up to a ceiling of 8 in any one attribute. You cannot spend more than four, and you cannot carry unspent points into the game, but you do not have to spend them all. The badge on the right of the screen counts what is left. RESET TO DEFAULT puts every attribute back to its minimum and returns all four points.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 五项属性描述的是你受过的训练，而不是你曾经是谁：体质、反应、智力、技术能力和冷静。每一项从 3 开始，也就是一个从未被要求做任何困难事情的普通健康成年人的水平。你的生命轨迹会把其中两项提高到下限，这些下限不能被降低；套件会用“最低等级”作为提醒来标记它们。然后你有四个免费点数，可以任意组合分配，任何一项最高为 8 级。你不能花超过四点，也不能把没用完的点数带进游戏，但你不必全部用完。屏幕右侧的徽章显示还剩多少。“重置为默认”会把每项属性放回下限，并归还全部四个点。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Every attribute works the same way. The effects are counted per level above 3, so an attribute at level 3 does nothing, at level 4 does one step, at level 8 does five steps. The steps are small on purpose. No single attribute can make you invincible, and none of them replaces the lifepath. What they do is shave and add at the edges: a few percent on your dash here, a few points of Integrity there, until the sum of a good spread feels like a different person.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 每项属性的运作方式都相同。效果按超过 3 的每一级计算，所以 3 级的属性什么都不做，4 级做一档，8 级做五档。每一档都有意设得很小。没有任何单项属性能让你无敌，也没有任何一项能取代生命轨迹。它们做的是在边缘上削减和增加：冲刺上多几个百分点，完整度上多几点，直到一组好的分配加起来，感觉像另一个人。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Because the minimums are part of the lifepath, the quoted figures in each lifepath section already include them. The rest of this section lists only what each attribute does, level by level, so that you can reason about what four more points will buy.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 由于下限是生命轨迹的一部分，每个生命轨迹一节中引用的数字已经包含了它们。这一节的其余部分只列出每项属性逐级做了什么，方便你推算再多四点能买到什么。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Body
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 体质

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Body is the length of time you stay standing. Each level above 3 adds seven points to your maximum Integrity and reduces the damage you take by two percent. At level 4 that is 107 Integrity and one fewer percent in every ten that lands on you; at level 6 it is 121 and six percent; at the maximum, level 8, it is 135 Integrity and ten percent less damage from everything, which together make you about half again as hard to kill as someone with Body 3.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 体质是你能站着多久。每超过 3 的一级，最大完整度增加七点，受到的伤害减少百分之二。4 级时是 107 点完整度，每十点打在你身上的伤害少一点；6 级是 121 点和百分之六；最高的 8 级是 135 点完整度，所有伤害减少百分之十，合起来大约比体质 3 的人难杀一半。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Body matters most to the lifepaths that heal and the lifepaths that run. For a Lantern Row Kid, every extra point of maximum Integrity is a point that regeneration, medkits and the Analogue Kit all scale against, because the Kit restores a share of your total. For a Courier, Body is the answer to the lifepath's drawback: it offsets the extra damage you take, and a few levels of it turn a glass cannon into a fast, durable skirmisher. For a Contractor it is the cheapest cure for the ten points of Integrity the lifepath takes away.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 体质对治疗型和奔跑型的生命轨迹最重要。对灯笼街少年来说，每多一点最大完整度，再生、医疗包和模拟工具包就多一点可以作用的基数，因为工具包恢复的是总量的一个比例。对信使来说，体质是对这条轨迹缺点的回答：它抵消了你多受的伤害，几级体质就能把一门玻璃大炮变成一个又快又耐打的游击手。对外包员来说，它是补回这条轨迹拿走的十点完整度最便宜的办法。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Reflexes
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 反应

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Reflexes is the gap between deciding and doing. Each level above 3 makes your dash recharge four percent faster, reduces your weapon recoil by four percent, shortens reloads by three percent and raises your walking and running speed by one percent. They compound with whatever the lifepath already gave you, so a Courier at Reflexes 8 stacks a lifepath dash recharge of 75 percent with a further twenty percent from the attribute, which comes to a cooldown of about 0.48 seconds.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 反应是决定与行动之间的间隙。每超过 3 的一级，冲刺恢复快百分之四，武器后坐力减少百分之四，换弹缩短百分之三，行走和奔跑速度提高百分之一。它们会与生命轨迹已经给你的东西叠加，所以一个反应 8 的信使会把生命轨迹的百分之七十五冲刺恢复再叠上属性带来的百分之二十，结果是大约 0.48 秒的冷却。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: It is the easiest attribute to feel. Recoil and reload are the two numbers a shooter notices most, and dash recharge is the number that decides how often you can leave a bad position. If you are unsure where to put a free point, put it here. It helps every lifepath, and it helps the Lantern Row Kid most, because that lifepath is the one that does not touch movement at all.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这是最容易感觉到的属性。后坐力和换弹是射手最留意的两个数字，而冲刺恢复是决定你多久能离开糟糕位置的数字。如果你不确定免费点该放在哪里，就放在这里。它对每条生命轨迹都有帮助，对灯笼街少年帮助最大，因为那条轨迹完全不涉及移动。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Intelligence
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 智力

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Intelligence is your capacity in a network. Each level above 3 reduces the cost of your EMP pulse by three Energy, extends the ICE trace by six percent and adds three to your maximum Energy. Two thresholds sit on top of that. At level 6 your ICE buffer, the number of wrong codes you can hold before the network rejects the attempt, grows by one. At level 7 every ICE sequence is one code shorter, stacking with any other shortening you already have, although no sequence can drop below one code.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 智力是你在网络中的容量。每超过 3 的一级，电磁脉冲的消耗减少三点能量，破冰追踪延长百分之六，最大能量增加三点。在此之上有两个门槛。到 6 级时，你的破冰缓冲区，也就是网络拒绝这次尝试之前你能容纳的错误代码数，增加一个。到 7 级时，每个破冰序列短一个代码，与你已有的其他缩短叠加，但任何序列都不会短于一个代码。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The attribute pays most to a Contractor, who gains on every axis at once, and to anyone who has made hacking the centre of their play. It pays least to a Courier who never touches a terminal. Remember, though, that the EMP pulse is a combat tool as well as a hacking tool: it stuns every enemy within ten metres for about three and a half seconds (five for drones, which also take damage) and wipes hostile projectiles out of the air, and at Intelligence 8 it costs 15 Energy less than baseline. A low-Intelligence character who still wants to use the pulse should plan on spending more of a dash bar to do it.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这项属性对外包员回报最大，他们在每个方面同时受益，对以黑入为核心的玩家也是如此。对从不碰终端的信使回报最小。不过请记住，电磁脉冲既是黑入工具，也是战斗工具：它会让十米内的每个敌人晕眩约三秒半（无人机五秒，并且会受到伤害），还会把敌方弹体从空中清除；在智力 8 时它比基线便宜 15 点能量。一个智力低却仍想使用脉冲的角色，应当计划为此多花一些冲刺的能量。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Technical Ability
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 技术能力

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Technical Ability is the ability to make machines do more than they were built to. Each level above 3 adds two percent to the damage of every weapon you fire, adds three points to every medkit you pick up and adds one and a half percentage points to the amount that Noah's Analogue Kit restores. At the maximum level, that is ten percent more damage, fifteen more points from a medkit and seven and a half more percentage points from the Kit, on top of whatever your lifepath already gave.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 技术能力是让机器做到超出其设计的能力。每超过 3 的一级，你射出的每件武器伤害增加百分之二，你捡起的每个医疗包增加三点，诺亚的模拟工具包恢复量增加一点五个百分点。到最高级时，就是多百分之十的伤害，医疗包多十五点，工具包多七点五个百分点，这些都在你的生命轨迹已经给你的东西之上。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: It is the quiet attribute, and it is the best place for a free point when you are not sure what you need. The damage bonus applies to everything, including melee, thrown weapons and drone fire, and the healing bonus is exactly what a long operation wears down. It is also the only attribute that gives back what the Lantern Row Kid's lifepath takes away in weapon damage: the Kid's five percent penalty is more than repaid at Technical Ability 6.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 它是安静的属性，也是你不确定自己需要什么时放免费点的最佳去处。伤害加成适用于一切，包括近战、投掷武器和无人机火力，而治疗加成恰好是长时间行动所消耗的东西。它也是唯一能补回灯笼街少年那条轨迹在武器伤害上扣掉的属性：少年的百分之五惩罚，在技术能力 6 时就被还清还有余。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Cool
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 冷静

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Cool is poise. Each level above 3 makes guards notice you three percent more slowly, makes you move four percent faster while sneaking and reduces how quickly Helix Heat builds by four percent. At level 8, guards fill their detection meters at 85 percent of the normal rate, your sneaking speed is twenty percent higher and Heat builds at four fifths of the usual pace.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 冷静是镇定。每超过 3 的一级，守卫发现你的速度慢百分之三，潜行时移动快百分之四，螺旋通缉的上升速度慢百分之四。到 8 级时，守卫以正常速度的百分之八十五填充侦测条，你的潜行速度高百分之二十，通缉按平常五分之四的速度上升。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Cool is the only attribute that reduces the cost of being seen, which is why the drawbacks of two of the three lifepaths point directly at it. A Kid or a Contractor, both of whom are punished by Heat, will find that three or four levels of Cool offset a substantial part of the penalty. A Courier, whose sneaking is the weakest in the Suite, will find that the same levels bring it most of the way back to normal. It is also the best partner for the stealthy weapons and the quiet takedowns, because everything about a successful sneak is a matter of seconds.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 冷静是唯一能降低被发现代价的属性，这就是为什么三条生命轨迹中有两条的缺点直接指向它。少年或外包员都会被通缉惩罚，三四级冷静就能抵消惩罚的相当一部分。潜行最弱的信使会发现同样的等级能把它拉回接近正常。它也是静音武器和无声击倒的最佳搭档，因为一次成功的潜行说到底就是几秒钟的事。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Spending four points
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 分配四点

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: There is no wrong spread, but there are a few honest ones. The generalist puts one point into each of four attributes and leaves the fifth at its minimum; this is the safest way to learn the game and is never a mistake. The specialist puts all four into one attribute and goes to level 7 or 8 in it, picking up the thresholds and the biggest stacking bonuses; the Reflexes specialist and the Intelligence specialist are the two most distinctive builds. The patcher spends two points on Body and two on Technical Ability, and does not die very often. The ghost spends all four on Cool and then spends the game proving to the guards that they could not see you; Contractors and Couriers are the best at this.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 没有错误的分配，但有几种老实的分配。通才在四项属性上各放一点，让第五项留在下限；这是学习游戏最安全的方式，从来不会出错。专才把四点全放进一项属性，让它达到 7 级或 8 级，拿到门槛和最大的叠加加成；反应专才和智力专才是两种最有特点的搭配。补给手把两点放进体质，两点放进技术能力，不怎么会死。幽灵把四点全放进冷静，然后用整场游戏向守卫证明他们看不见你；外包员和信使最擅长这个。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Two warnings. First, the minimums are a gift and a trap: a lifepath's two floors are the things it is already good at, and adding to them has diminishing returns compared with adding to an attribute at 3, where the first extra level costs one point and does one full step. Second, it is easy to spend all four on what feels exciting and none on what keeps you alive. Whatever else you choose, make sure that at least one point goes into Body or Reflexes. You can always remake the character from the Journal, with all of your progress intact, once you know what you wish you had chosen.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 两个提醒。第一，下限既是礼物也是陷阱：一条生命轨迹的两个下限是它已经擅长的东西，而在它们上面增加的回报递减，不如加在 3 级的属性上，那里第一个额外等级只花一点，却能完整地做一档。第二，很容易把四点全花在让你兴奋的东西上，而一点都不花在让你活着的东西上。无论如何选择，确保至少有一点放进体质或反应。一旦你知道自己想要选什么，随时可以从日志里重塑角色，所有进度都完好无损。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: THREE FINISHED CHARACTERS
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 三个成型的角色

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Patcher
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 补给手

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A Lantern Row Kid who spent their free points on two levels of Body and two of Technical Ability. The levels end at Body 5, Reflexes 3, Intelligence 3, Technical Ability 6 and Cool 5. The numbers: medkits restore 54 Integrity, the Analogue Kit restores 74.5 percent of your maximum, you have 114 Integrity and take four percent less damage, regeneration is still 1.5 per second, credits are still ×1.30, weapon damage is now ×1.007, so the Kid's penalty has more than repaid itself, guards notice you at 94 percent of their normal rate, you sneak eight percent faster and Heat builds at ×1.196. In play, this character walks into a firefight, takes a few hits, ducks behind a crate and is back at nearly full health thirty seconds later with a pocket full of credits. It is not a thrilling build. It is an extremely hard one to put down.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 一个把免费点花在两级体质和两级技术能力上的灯笼街少年。最终等级为体质 5、反应 3、智力 3、技术能力 6、冷静 5。数字如下：医疗包恢复 54 点完整度，模拟工具包恢复你最大值的百分之七十四点五，你有 114 点完整度并且受到的伤害少百分之四，再生仍然是每秒 1.5，信用点仍然是 ×1.30，武器伤害现在是 ×1.007，也就是少年的惩罚已经被还清有余，守卫以正常速度的百分之九十四发现你，你潜行快百分之八，通缉按 ×1.196 上升。在游戏里，这个角色走进枪战，挨几下，躲到一个箱子后面，三十秒后几乎满血回来，口袋里还塞满了信用点。它不是令人兴奋的搭配。但它极难被放倒。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Quiet Hand
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 安静的手

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A Helix Contractor who spent three points on Cool and one on Body. The levels end at Body 4, Reflexes 3, Intelligence 5, Technical Ability 3 and Cool 7. The numbers: guards notice you at 57 percent of their normal rate, you sneak sixteen percent faster, Heat builds at ×1.05, so most of the lifepath's penalty is gone, ICE sequences are one code shorter, the EMP pulse costs 34 Energy, the ICE trace lasts 40 percent longer, credits are ×1.10, maximum Energy is 106 and maximum Integrity is 97 after the Contractor's ten-point loss is partly repaid. In play, this character is rarely noticed at all, and on the occasions when it is, the first few seconds of a bad situation are almost always long enough to leave. It is the closest thing the Suite offers to a ghost in the traditional sense.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 一个把三点放在冷静、一点放在体质上的螺旋外包员。最终等级为体质 4、反应 3、智力 5、技术能力 3、冷静 7。数字如下：守卫以正常速度的百分之五十七发现你，你潜行快百分之十六，通缉按 ×1.05 上升，所以这条轨迹的大部分惩罚都没有了，破冰序列短一个代码，电磁脉冲消耗 34 点能量，破冰追踪延长百分之四十，信用点 ×1.10，最大能量 106，最大完整度 97，因为外包员失去的十点已经被补回一部分。在游戏里，这个角色几乎不会被注意到，而在被注意到的少数时候，糟糕局面最初的几秒几乎总是足够离开。这是套件所能提供的、最接近传统意义上的幽灵的东西。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Rushdown
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 突袭者

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A Glass Wastes Courier who spent all four points on Reflexes. The levels end at Body 4, Reflexes 8, Intelligence 3, Technical Ability 3 and Cool 3. The numbers: movement speed ×1.155, dash recharge of 0.48 seconds, dash cost of 17 Energy, maximum Energy 120, recoil ×0.72, reload time ×0.807, maximum Integrity 107, damage taken ×1.078 and sneaking speed ×0.80. In play, this character cannot sneak and does not try. It crosses an open street in four dashes, fires from the hip between them and reloads while moving. It is the fastest thing in the city, and it is one mistake away from needing a medkit it did not bring. If you want a build that feels like a stunt, this is it.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 一个把四点全花在反应上的玻璃荒原信使。最终等级为体质 4、反应 8、智力 3、技术能力 3、冷静 3。数字如下：移动速度 ×1.155，冲刺恢复 0.48 秒，冲刺消耗 17 点能量，最大能量 120，后坐力 ×0.72，换弹时间 ×0.807，最大完整度 107，受到伤害 ×1.078，潜行速度 ×0.80。在游戏里，这个角色不能潜行，也不去尝试。它用四次冲刺穿过一条空街，在冲刺之间腰射，边走边换弹。它是城里最快的东西，也离一次失误后需要它没带的医疗包只差一步。如果你想要一个像特技表演的搭配，就是它。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: DIFFICULTY
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 难度

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Four ways to be pushed
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 四种被逼迫的方式

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The last screen of the Suite asks how hard the city should push back. Four buttons answer it. Each of them is a small set of multipliers, applied to everyone who is trying to hurt you, plus a few rules about what you are allowed to do when it goes wrong. None of them changes the story. The same people say the same things and die in the same places; only the cost of getting there is different. You can change the difficulty at any time from the Journal by remaking the character, with one exception that is described below.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 套件的最后一个画面会问城市该用多大力气反击。四个按钮回答这个问题。每个按钮都是一小组倍率，作用于所有想伤害你的人，外加几条关于出错时你被允许做什么的规则。它们都不会改变故事。同样的人说同样的话，在同样的地方死去；只有到达那里的代价不同。你随时可以从日志里通过重塑角色来更改难度，只有一个例外，下面会说明。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Story
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 剧情

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Story is for people who came for the city and the people in it. Enemies deal 45 percent of the normal damage, have 70 percent of the normal health and notice you at 70 percent of the normal rate. Guards stay patient for a long time, drones are fragile and a fight that would end a stranger in a corridor is a stumble. Operations can be restarted or skipped altogether from the pause menu: if a level is giving you trouble, you may carry on with the story without clearing it and no one in the city will mention it. Story is not a lesser way to play. It is the way the writers hoped you might play the first time.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 剧情难度是给为了城市和城里的人而来的玩家。敌人只造成正常伤害的百分之四十五，只有正常的百分之七十生命，并以正常速度的百分之七十注意到你。守卫耐心很足，无人机很脆弱，一场会让陌生人倒在走廊里的战斗对你只是一次绊脚。行动可以从暂停菜单重新开始，或者干脆跳过：如果某一关让你为难，你可以不通关就继续故事，城里没有人会提起。剧情难度并不是较差的玩法。它是编剧们希望你第一次玩时采用的方式。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Operative
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 特工

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Operative is the intended balance, and everything in this handbook is calibrated against it. Enemies deal normal damage, have normal health and notice you at the normal rate. The numbers in the lifepath sections describe the differences between you and an average operator on Operative; on the other difficulties, the same differences hold, but the baseline moves underneath them. If you have no strong feeling about difficulty, choose this one.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 特工是预期的平衡，这份手册里的一切都以它为基准校准。敌人造成正常伤害，有正常生命，以正常速度注意到你。生命轨迹各节中的数字描述的是你和特工难度下普通操作员的差别；在其他难度上，同样的差别依然成立，只是基线在它们下面移动了。如果你对难度没有强烈的想法，就选这个。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Ghost Protocol
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 幽灵协议

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Ghost Protocol is for people who found Operative comfortable. Enemies deal 50 percent more damage, have 30 percent more health and notice you 30 percent faster. This is a smaller change than it sounds and a larger one than it looks: guards who notice you quicker are guards who shoot you sooner, and enemies with more health ask more of your ammunition and your aim. It rewards everything the lifepaths reward. A stealth character is much better off on Ghost Protocol, because each metre of undetected progress is a metre of the harder fight avoided; a heavy fighter will learn to love cover.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 幽灵协议是给觉得特工难度太舒服的人。敌人造成多百分之五十的伤害，生命多百分之三十，发现你的速度快百分之三十。这个变化比听起来小，又比看起来大：更快发现你的守卫会更早向你开枪，生命更多的敌人会更多地消耗你的弹药和准头。它奖励生命轨迹所奖励的一切。潜行型角色在幽灵协议上好得多，因为每一米未被发现的前进都是少打了一场更难的战斗；重火力角色会学会爱上掩体。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Hardcore
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 硬核

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Hardcore is a different game that happens to look the same. Enemies deal twice the normal damage, have 40 percent more health and notice you 50 percent faster. You carry half the ammunition: your reserve limit for every type is halved, and so is what you can pick up, so every round is a decision. The screen and the minimap show no markers. There are no waypoints, no enemy dots and no objective rings; the minimap draws streets and rooms and nothing else, and the only way to find what you need is to look. Retries and skips are closed.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 硬核是另一款恰好长得一样的游戏。敌人造成两倍伤害，生命多百分之四十，发现你的速度快百分之五十。你携带的弹药只有一半：每种类型的储备上限减半，能捡到的也减半，所以每一发子弹都是一个决定。屏幕和小地图上没有任何标记。没有路标，没有敌人圆点，没有目标圈；小地图只画街道和房间，仅此而已，找到你需要的东西的唯一办法就是用眼睛看。重试和跳过也关闭了。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: And the save is mortal. If you fail an operation on Hardcore, whether by dying or by running out of time, the save is marked dead at that instant and erased when the screen closes. Closing the tab does not help, because the mark is written before anything else is. If you play with an account, the cloud copy is replaced with a marker that cannot be restored. What survives is exactly one thing: the endings you have unlocked stay unlocked, so a Hardcore run that goes badly still counts toward the story. Free roam, story scenes and multiplayer cannot end a Hardcore run; only an operation can.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 而且存档是会死的。如果你在硬核难度下行动失败，无论是死亡还是超时，存档在那一刻就被标记为死亡，并在画面关闭时被抹去。关掉标签页没有用，因为标记是在其他一切之前写下的。如果你使用账号，云端副本会被替换成一个无法恢复的标记。唯一幸存的是一件事：你已经解锁的结局依然保持解锁，所以一次进行得不好的硬核流程仍然算进故事。自由漫游、剧情场景和多人联机不会终结硬核流程；只有行动可以。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A Hardcore save also does not go back. Remaking the character in the Journal lets you change every other row, but the difficulty row will refuse anything below Hardcore. That is deliberate. The mode is meant to feel like a promise.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 硬核存档也不会往回走。在日志里重塑角色可以让你改变其他每一行，但难度那一行拒绝任何比硬核低的选项。这是有意的。这个模式本就应当像一个承诺。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Choosing
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 如何选择

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: If you are unsure, pick Operative and change it later; you lose nothing by trying. If you are choosing for a lifepath, the sensible matches are these: the Lantern Row Kid is best on Operative or Story, because the lifepath rewards patience and a regeneration that trivialises Story but is a real advantage on Operative; the Helix Contractor is at its sharpest on Ghost Protocol, where early detection matters most; the Glass Wastes Courier is the lifepath for Hardcore, if you are brave, because in a mode with no markers and half the ammunition the ability to keep moving is the only reliable defence.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 如果你拿不准，就选特工，之后再改；试一试你什么都不会失去。如果你是在为某条生命轨迹选择，合理的搭配是这样的：灯笼街少年在特工或剧情难度下最好，因为这条轨迹奖励耐心，而它的再生在剧情难度下太过轻松，在特工难度下却是真正的优势；螺旋外包员在幽灵协议下最锋利，那里早期侦测最要紧；玻璃荒原信使是适合硬核的生命轨迹，如果你足够勇敢的话，因为在没有标记、弹药减半的模式里，保持移动的能力是唯一可靠的防御。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: APPEARANCE, VOICE AND CYBERWARE
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 外貌、声音与义体

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What you can change
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你可以改变什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The second screen of the Suite is the only one with no numbers in it, and it is the one that most people spend longest on. You can start from one of six presets or build a face from nothing. There are twelve skin tones, from the palest to the deepest, and eight hairstyles: the Courier Hood, Buzz Cut, Undercut, Mohawk, Bob, Long, Top Knot and Braids. Ten hair colours run from natural black to colours that never occur in nature. Your eyes can be a Visor, a pair of Optics or Shades. Five levels of cyberware, from None through Cheek Lines, a Jaw Plate and a Temple Port to Full Chrome, add lit lines and plates to your face in your glow colour. The glow colour itself is one of eight, and it appears again in the visor, in the lit seams of your gloves and on every cuff. Finally, the jacket is one of eight colours, and it is the colour that every sleeve in the first-person view wears.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 套件的第二个画面是唯一没有数字的一个，也是大多数人停留最久的一个。你可以从六个预设之一开始，也可以从零造一张脸。有十二种肤色，从最浅到最深，还有八种发型：信使兜帽、寸头、削边短发、莫霍克、波波头、长发、发髻和辫子。十种发色，从自然的黑色到自然界里从不存在的颜色。你的眼睛可以是目镜、光学义眼或墨镜。五档义体，从无、脸颊纹路、下颌板、太阳穴接口一直到全身镀铬，会以你的光色在脸上添加发光的线条和板件。光色本身有八种选择，它会再次出现在目镜里、手套上发光的接缝里和每一个袖口上。最后，夹克有八种颜色，第一人称视角里每一条袖子都会穿着这个颜色。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Voice is the last row. Low, Mid and High change the pitch of Ghost's speech when the game reads dialogue aloud and the pitch of the small chirp that accompanies each line of text. It does not change what is said or how people respond to it.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 声音是最后一行。低、中、高会改变游戏朗读对白时幽灵说话的音高，以及伴随每行文字的小提示音的音高。它不会改变说了什么，也不会改变别人如何回应。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What it does, and what it doesn't
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 它做什么，不做什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Nothing on this screen changes a number. Your look does not make guards notice you more or less, it does not change how much Integrity you have and it does not change how the story treats you. This is a rule of the Suite and not a limitation: the Bureau decided long ago that the face is the one thing that must never be a tactical choice, because the moment it is, everyone's face becomes the same one.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这个画面上没有任何东西会改变数值。你的外貌不会让守卫更容易或更难注意到你，不会改变你有多少完整度，也不会改变故事如何对待你。这是套件的规则而不是限制：档案局很久以前就决定，脸是绝不能成为战术选择的东西，因为一旦它成为战术选择，每个人的脸都会变成同一张。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What it does do is appear. Your portrait is drawn from your look, in every conversation, in the Journal and on the character screen. In multiplayer, other operators see you wearing it. In the first-person view, your sleeves and the light on your gloves come from the jacket and the glow colour, so that the arms you see in the middle of a firefight are recognisably yours. And in a few quiet scenes, where the camera lingers on you rather than the situation, there is a small pleasure in finding that the person on the screen looks the way you meant.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 它做的是出现。你的肖像由你的外貌绘制，出现在每一次对话、日志和角色画面里。在多人联机中，其他特工会看到你穿着它。在第一人称视角里，你的袖子和手套上的光来自夹克和光色，所以你在枪战中看到的双臂是一眼就能认出的你自己。在少数几个安静的场景里，镜头停留在你身上而不是局势上，会有一种小小的愉悦：屏幕上的人看起来就是你想要的样子。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Presets and the grid
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 预设与色板

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The six presets on the left are good starting points rather than fixed characters; picking one fills every row at once, and you can change anything afterwards. The rows on the right can be clicked on either arrow, or moved with the keyboard or controller. The grid between the arrows, on rows that offer a choice of colours, opens the full set so that you can pick the one you want without stepping through the others. Pick a colour and the grid closes.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 左边的六个预设是不错的起点，而不是固定角色；选择其中一个会一次填满每一行，之后你可以改变任何东西。右边的各行可以点击任一箭头，也可以用键盘或手柄移动。在提供颜色选择的行里，箭头之间的方格会打开完整色板，这样你就能直接选想要的颜色，不必逐个翻过其他的。选好颜色后色板会关闭。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You can change your look at any time by remaking the character from the Journal. It never affects progress, and it is the cheapest change in the game: nothing is reset, nothing is lost, and nothing about the story notices.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你可以随时通过日志重塑角色来改变外貌。它从不影响进度，也是游戏里代价最小的改变：什么都不会重置，什么都不会丢失，故事也不会察觉。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: THE FIRST HOUR: ADVICE FOR NEW OPERATORS
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 第一小时：给新特工的建议

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Before the first door
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 在第一扇门之前

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The first operation of any story is a teacher in disguise. It will show you what the city is willing to put in front of you and how you respond, and it is gentle enough that almost any build can finish it. Treat it as a laboratory. Walk the whole length of the first level before you attempt it for real. Try the dash on every surface, fire a few rounds at a wall to feel the recoil, and open the pause menu to read the weapon in your hand. Learning what your lifepath feels like costs nothing in the first level and a lot in the fourth.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 任何故事的第一场行动都是一位伪装起来的老师。它会向你展示城市愿意把什么摆在你面前，以及你如何应对，而且它温和得几乎任何搭配都能通过。把它当作实验室。在真正尝试之前，先走完第一关的全程。在每种表面上试试冲刺，对着墙开几枪感受后坐力，打开暂停菜单读一读手里的武器。了解你的生命轨迹是什么感觉，在第一关里不花任何代价，在第四关里却会花很多。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Read your own numbers before you trust them. The lifepath sections of this handbook quote exact values, and those are right to the decimal, but the feel of a number is not the same as the number. A dash recharge of 0.55 seconds sounds like nothing until you discover you can cross a plaza in three dashes; a detection rate of 63 percent sounds like a statistic until a guard stares at you for an extra second and you realise you are still unseen. Play with the numbers until they are habits.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 在相信自己的数字之前先读一读它们。这份手册的生命轨迹各节引用了精确的数值，精确到小数点，但一个数字的手感并不等于这个数字。0.55 秒的冲刺恢复听起来什么都不是，直到你发现自己三次冲刺就能穿过一座广场；百分之六十三的侦测速率听起来只是个统计数字，直到有个守卫多盯了你一秒钟，而你意识到自己仍未被发现。玩一玩这些数字，直到它们变成习惯。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What to do in the first hour
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 第一小时该做什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Take every medkit and every shard. Both are small, both are rarely out of the way and both pay back in the second hour. Learn the takedown early: it is the most efficient action in the game, because it ends a threat in one press, costs nothing and pays full credits. Learn to listen. Guards talk, drones whine before they appear and footsteps carry; half of stealth is hearing a patrol turn a corner before you can see it. Learn the map: the minimap on the right turns with you, the bar beneath it tells you what the guards think, and the yellow marks tell you where to go. On Hardcore, the marks are gone and the map shows streets only, so it is best to have the habit of looking by then.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 捡起每一个医疗包和每一块碎片。两者都小，都很少离路线太远，也都会在第二个小时里回报你。早点学会击倒：它是游戏里最高效的动作，一次按键就结束威胁，什么都不花，还能拿到全额信用点。学会倾听。守卫会说话，无人机在出现之前会先嗡嗡作响，脚步声会传得很远；潜行有一半是在看到巡逻队转过街角之前就听见它。学会看地图：右边的小地图会随你转动，它下面的条告诉你守卫在想什么，黄色标记告诉你该往哪里去。在硬核难度下，标记不见了，地图只显示街道，所以到那时最好已经养成了用眼睛看的习惯。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Spend your credits on the Black Market early rather than late. The first weapon upgrade is the best value the game offers, and the first ammunition conversion changes what a rifle is for. If your lifepath earns extra credits, this is the moment it shows; if it does not, the first hour is when you learn what you can afford.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 把信用点早点而不是晚点花在黑市上。第一次武器升级是游戏提供的最划算的买卖，第一次弹药转换会改变一支步枪的用途。如果你的生命轨迹能多赚信用点，这就是它显现的时刻；如果不能，第一个小时就是你了解自己买得起什么的时候。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Use the Journal. It remembers what you have been told and by whom, and it is where the Suite lives: if the first hour tells you that your build is wrong, you can open the Journal, remake the character with your progress intact, spend the points differently and be back at the door in a minute. Nobody should finish a first hour with a build they dislike when the Suite is two clicks away.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 使用日志。它记得别人告诉过你什么以及是谁说的，而且套件就住在那里：如果第一个小时告诉你你的搭配不对，你可以打开日志，带着进度重塑角色，换一种方式花点数，一分钟后就回到门口。当套件近在两次点击之外时，没有人应当带着一个自己不喜欢的搭配结束第一个小时。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What not to do
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 不该做什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Do not fight a patrol you could have avoided, if you are a Contractor. Do not hoard medkits, if you are a Kid. Do not stop moving, if you are a Courier. Do not spend every point on the thing you are already good at in the first hour, because you do not know yet which of your weaknesses you will meet most. And do not ignore the Heat meter. The diamonds at the top of the screen are not decoration. At one diamond the squads are looking for you; at three they are coming; at five, you are not going to win the fight you are in, so you should be leaving it.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 如果你是外包员，不要打一场本可以避开的巡逻战。如果你是少年，不要囤医疗包。如果你是信使，不要停下来。不要在第一个小时就把所有点数花在你已经擅长的东西上，因为你还不知道自己最常遇到的是哪一个弱点。也不要忽视通缉条。屏幕顶部的菱形不是装饰。一颗菱形时，小队在找你；三颗时，他们正在赶来；五颗时，你已经赢不了你正在打的这场仗，所以应该离开它。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A word about trust
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 关于信任

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The story in New Avalon keeps five ledgers: Raven Trust, Voss Integrity, Civilian Hope, Corporate Leverage and AI Sympathy. Your lifepath gives you a head start in some of them and a deficit in others, and the starting values are listed in each lifepath section. They matter most in the first third of the story, when the people around you have not yet decided what you are. After that, your own choices take over. Do not choose a lifepath for its trust bonuses alone. A few points are not the story. They are a nudge, and the story will take its own direction regardless.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 新阿瓦隆的故事保存着五本账簿：渡鸦信任、沃斯操守、平民希望、企业筹码和AI同情。你的生命轨迹在其中几本里给了你领先，在另几本里给了你亏空，初始数值在每条生命轨迹那一节里都列出了。它们在故事的前三分之一最重要，那时你身边的人还没有决定你是什么。之后，你自己的选择会接管一切。不要只为了信任加成就选一条生命轨迹。几个点不是故事。它们只是轻轻推你一把，而故事无论如何都会走自己的方向。
