PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: QUESTIONS THE BUREAU IS ASKED MOST OFTEN
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 档案局被问得最多的问题

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Can I change my lifepath later?
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 我以后可以更换生命轨迹吗？

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Yes. Open the Journal and choose Remake Character. The four screens open with your current choices filled in. You can change any of them, and your progress is kept. The one limit is Hardcore, which cannot be lowered.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 可以。打开日志，选择重塑角色。四个画面会带着你当前的选择打开。你可以改变其中任何一个，进度会被保留。唯一的限制是硬核，它不能被降低。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Do the minimums count against my four points?
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 下限会占用我的四个点吗？

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: No. The minimums are free; they belong to the lifepath. The four points are always yours to spend, and RESET TO DEFAULT returns you to the minimums with all four points available.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 不会。下限是免费的；它们属于生命轨迹。这四个点始终由你支配，“重置为默认”会让你回到下限，并保留全部四点。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Why are the effects so small?
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 为什么效果这么小？

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Because they add up, and because the game is meant to be about the person in the room rather than the file in the cabinet. A good spread of attributes is the difference between a build that survives and one that does not, but no spread makes an operation trivial.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 因为它们会累加，也因为这款游戏本来是关于房间里的人，而不是柜子里的档案。一组好的属性分配，是能活下来的搭配和活不下来的搭配之间的差别，但没有任何分配能让一场行动变得轻而易举。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What happens if I never open this document?
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 如果我从不打开这份文件会怎样？

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Nothing, apart from the possibility that you will never know why your guards seem so patient. The game does not require the dossier. It only declines to repeat it anywhere else.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 什么都不会发生，除了你可能永远不知道为什么你的守卫看起来那么有耐心。游戏并不需要这份档案。它只是拒绝在别处重复它。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Does multiplayer use my lifepath?
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 多人联机会用我的生命轨迹吗？

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: No. In shared sessions everyone fights with the same numbers, so that nobody meets a stranger who is simply better than they are. Your look is shared, because faces are the one thing you should always be able to recognise.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 不会。在共享联机中，所有人都用同样的数值战斗，这样没人会遇到一个单纯比自己强的陌生人。你的外貌是共享的，因为脸是你应当始终能认出来的东西。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Can I take this document with me?
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 我可以把这份文件带走吗？

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Yes. The buttons at the top of the reader save the whole dossier, only the passages you have extracted, or your own character record as a plain text file. On a phone running the Android app they open the share sheet instead, so you can send the file to Drive, Notes or mail. The game uploads nothing: the file is built on your device and handed to you.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 可以。阅读器顶部的按钮可以把整份档案、只是你摘录过的段落，或者你自己的角色记录保存为纯文本文件。在运行安卓应用的手机上，这些按钮会改为打开分享菜单，让你把文件发送到云端硬盘、备忘录或邮件。游戏不会上传任何东西：文件在你的设备上生成，然后交给你。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What does Export My Record contain?
序言：为什么会有这份文件: “导出我的记录”里有什么？

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A readable report of the character and save on this device: your lifepath and attributes, the difficulty, how far through the story you are, your standing with each faction, your balance, shards, stars and endings, your journal entries, side quests, memory fragments and mysteries, and then the raw save data underneath. It is your own data in a form you can keep, print or compare, and it is built on your device without being uploaded anywhere.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这是对这台设备上角色与存档的一份可读报告：你的生命轨迹与属性、难度、故事进行到哪里、你在各个势力眼中的声望、你的余额、数据碎片、纸星和结局、你的日志条目、支线任务、记忆碎片与谜团，最后在下面附上原始存档数据。这是你自己的数据，以你可以保存、打印或对比的形式交给你，并且全程在你的设备上生成，不会上传到任何地方。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: DESIGN NOTES
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 设计笔记

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What this terminal borrows
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这台终端借用了什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Suite is built to look like a civic-records kiosk: a red-black field, a cyan title, a thin line across the top, a column of tiny numbers down one edge and a button in each lower corner. That grammar is shared by a whole family of games and films about cities of neon and bureaucracy, and it is borrowed here on purpose, because it works. A character screen that looks like a terminal feels like a place where something official is about to be decided about you, and a chair in front of it feels like a seat in a waiting room.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 这个套件被做成一台市政档案亭的样子：红黑的底，青色的标题，顶部的一条细线，沿着一条边的一列小数字，以及两个下角各一个的按钮。这套语法被一大批关于霓虹与官僚主义之城的游戏和电影共享，在这里被有意借用，因为它有效。看起来像终端的角色画面，会让人感到这是一个即将有人对你做出官方决定的地方，而坐在它前面的椅子就像候诊室里的一个座位。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Everything on the screen is original to this game. The three cards, the alley, the glass canyon and the road are painted in code, on the fly, with no photographs and no stolen frames; the lanterns sway and the van's tail-lights pulse because a few lines of drawing instructions say so. The icons, the words and the numbers belong to Neon Veins. If the layout reminds you of another game's creation screen, that is because it is built on the same idea: a handful of large choices, each given room to breathe, each with a short paragraph of mood and nothing more.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 屏幕上的一切都是这款游戏原创的。三张卡片，小巷，玻璃峡谷和公路，都是用代码即时绘制的，没有照片，也没有盗用的画面；灯笼摇摆、货车的尾灯脉动，只因为几行绘图指令这么说。图标、文字和数字属于《霓虹血脉》。如果这个布局让你想起另一款游戏的创建画面，那是因为它建立在同一个想法上：少数几个大的选择，每个都有呼吸的空间，每个只配一小段气氛文字，别无其他。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Why the numbers hide
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 为什么数字被藏起来

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Most character creators put the numbers on the screen, and most players read the numbers before they read anything else. The designers of this one wanted people to choose the way the Bureau's clients choose: by what the life sounds like. Then, afterwards, to look it up. The dossier is the second step. It is long on purpose, because the numbers deserve a justification, and because the people who read to the end are the people who will appreciate that the Courier's twenty percent sneaking penalty is the exact weight of an unlit corridor.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 大多数角色创建器把数字摆在屏幕上，而大多数玩家在读别的任何东西之前先读数字。这个创建器的设计者希望人们像档案局的客户那样选择：凭这种生活听起来怎么样。然后，事后再去查。档案就是第二步。它被故意写得很长，因为数字值得一个交代，也因为读到最后的人会明白，信使那百分之二十的潜行惩罚，正好是一条没有灯的走廊的分量。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A last word
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 最后一句话

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The record in the Suite is not you. It is a coat you put on for the length of the story, and you can take it off at any time. Ghost, the one at the centre of all of this, is whatever you choose to do next. The Bureau thanks you for your patience and reminds you that your civic record is currently NOT FOUND.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 套件里的记录不是你。它是你在整个故事期间披上的一件外套，你随时可以脱下。幽灵，所有这一切的中心，就是你接下来所做的事。档案局感谢你的耐心，并提醒你，你的市政记录目前仍然是：未找到。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: THE NUALLINK: A NOTE ON THE IMPLANT THAT LISTENS
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 脑联：关于那枚会倾听的植入体

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What the link is
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 连线是什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Every courier of your generation carries a civic implant, and since the erasure yours has been registered as a Nuallink node. It takes calls and messages, it carries anything Helix wants to push into your head, and it is the one place where ASCENSION and Clawd can speak to you without a key or a terminal. Open it from the pause menu, from the Journal, or by pressing N during an operation.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你这一代的每个信使都带着一枚民用植入体，而自从身份被抹除以来，你的这一枚已登记为一个脑联节点。它接收来电和消息，承载螺旋想塞进你脑子里的一切，也是飞升和 Clawd 无需钥匙或终端就能对你说话的唯一地方。你可以从暂停菜单、日志打开它，或在行动中按 N。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The link is only live in solo play, and only in operations and the open city. It is switched off in tutorials, in co-op and in story scenes. Messages arrive by story position: a letter belongs to the start or the end of a chapter, and an older save simply receives everything it missed the first time it is opened.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 连线只在单人游戏里启用，也只在行动和开放城市中启用。教程、合作模式和剧情场景中它是关闭的。消息按剧情位置到达：一封信属于某一章的开头或结尾，而旧存档第一次打开时，会一次收到它之前错过的所有消息。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The trace
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 追踪

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: In infiltrations, hacks, explorations and retrievals, Helix watches the link while enemies hunt you. The TRACE meter on the HUD runs from 0 to 100. While a hostile is alerted to you it climbs by 10 a second, scaled by your detection multiplier (a steady Cool score and the Corporate lifepath slow it) and by the difficulty. While one is merely suspicious it climbs by 2 a second. While nobody has you it falls by only 0.7 a second, and not at all for four seconds after the last time you were hunted.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 在潜入、入侵、探索和回收行动中，敌人追捕你时螺旋会监视这条连线。HUD 上的追踪条从 0 到 100。只要有敌人已对你警觉，它每秒上升 10，并按你的侦测倍率（稳定的冷静值和企业生命轨迹会让它变慢）与难度缩放。若只是起疑，则每秒上升 2 点。没有任何人发现你时，它每秒仅下降 0.7，而且在你最后一次被追捕后的四秒内完全不会下降。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: At 100, Helix locks the line. The trace drops to 75, every hostile that is not holding a post learns where you are, four reinforcements arrive (five from Act 3 on), you lose 20 energy, and ASCENSION is cut off for 45 seconds. Nothing else happens, and a locked link recovers by itself. The way to play it is to treat the lock as a fine for being seen too long.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 到达 100 时，螺旋锁定线路。追踪降到 75，所有没有驻守岗位的敌人都会得知你的位置，四名增援赶到（第三幕起为五名），你损失 20 点能量，飞升被切断 45 秒。除此之外不会发生别的事，被锁的连线会自己恢复。最好的玩法，是把锁定当作被看见太久的罚款。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Intrusions
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 入侵

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: When the trace is at 30 or more and someone is hunting you, Helix starts pushing code through the link. An intrusion opens a window of only a second and a half with the words HELIX INTRUSION on screen. Press V inside it to raise a firewall: it costs 30 energy, lowers the trace by 5, and the next intrusion is held off for 12 seconds. If you miss, your map and markers go to static for ten seconds, the trace jumps by 15, and the next one waits 10 seconds. A Somatic Firewall Patch stops intrusions by itself while it lasts.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 追踪达到 30 或以上、且有人在追捕你时，螺旋开始通过连线推送代码。入侵会打开一个仅有一秒半的窗口，屏幕上出现“螺旋入侵”。在窗口内按 V 启动防火墙：消耗 30 点能量，追踪降低 5，下一次入侵会被推迟 12 秒。如果错过，你的地图和标记会出现十秒的雪花干扰，追踪上升 15，下一次入侵则要等 10 秒。防火墙补丁在持续期间会自动拦截入侵。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: ASCENSION
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 飞升

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: ASCENSION speaks on the link after Chapter 4. In the ASCENSION tab you choose one of two assists and press V in an operation to use it (R3 on a pad, the LINK button on a touch screen). Pathfinder marks every hostile near you for twelve seconds. Scramble freezes every hostile within fourteen metres for three seconds (a drone for four and a half). You get one assist per operation, or two if your AI Sympathy is 60 or higher; in the open city the only limit is a thirty-second recovery.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 第四章之后，飞升开始在连线上对你说话。在“飞升”标签里选择两种援助之一，在行动中按 V 使用（手柄为 R3，触屏为“连线”按钮）。探路者会在十二秒内标出你附近的每个敌人。扰乱会让十四米内的每个敌人僵住三秒（无人机四秒半）。每次行动你有一次援助，若你的AI同情达到 60 或更高则有两次；在开放城市里唯一的限制是三十秒的恢复时间。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Each assist adds 45 to the trace (it can raise it to 99 but never push it into a lock on its own) and a little to your AI Sympathy. Its answers in the tab change with that standing: wary below 35, listening up to 65, trusting above. Nothing it says changes the story, but it will remember how you spoke to it.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 每次援助会给追踪加 45（最多把它推到 99，但本身绝不会触发锁定），并稍微提高你的AI同情。标签里它的回答会随这份关系而变化：低于 35 为戒备，到 65 为倾听，高于 65 为信任。它说的任何话都不会改变剧情，但它会记得你是怎样跟它说话的。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Ghost Mode and the scrubber
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 幽灵模式与清除器

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: In the HELIX tab you can switch the link off. In Ghost Mode there is no trace and there are no intrusions, but also no briefing, no live calls and no ASCENSION in an operation. Your inbox still fills. A Signal Scrubber does the opposite job for thirty seconds: it sets the trace to 0, lifts a lock, and makes the trace fall at 3.5 a second whatever is hunting you, with no intrusions at all.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 在“螺旋”标签里可以关闭连线。幽灵模式下没有追踪，也没有入侵，但行动中也没有简报、没有实时通话、没有飞升。你的收件箱仍会不断收到消息。信号清除器在三十秒内起相反的作用：它把追踪归零、解除锁定，并让追踪无论谁在追捕你都以每秒 3.5 的速度下降，同时完全没有入侵。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Clawd and CrustAI
序言：为什么会有这份文件: Clawd 与 CrustAI

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: At the start of an operation Clawd reads out what the director has planned for you: the twist, and any complications. It does this the first time with a short note about the trace. Clawd speaks through CrustAI, which translates what you cannot read. Encrypted messages decode when you open them and keep their text afterwards; if your game is not in English, every message carries the same label, TRANSLATED BY CRUSTAI. The CLAWD tab explains the link in plain words and has three intercepts you can decode for practice.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 行动开始时，Clawd 会读出导演为你安排的内容：转折，以及各种变数。第一次时它还会附上一小段关于追踪的说明。Clawd 通过 CrustAI 说话，由 CrustAI 翻译你读不懂的东西。加密消息在你打开时解码，之后保持原文；如果你的游戏不是英文，每条消息都会带上同样的标签：由 CRUSTAI 翻译。“CLAWD”标签用大白话解释这条连线，并附有三段可用来练习解码的截获通信。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: EVERY DOOR IN NEW AVALON: A NOTE ON GOING INSIDE
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 新阿瓦隆的每一扇门：关于进入室内的说明

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Doors
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 门

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: In the open city every building has a door: a glowing frame on a street-facing side, 1,133 of them in all (996 ordinary buildings and the 137 landmarks that have a solid footprint). The frame is coloured by what is behind it, so a noodle bar reads differently from a clinic from down the street. Walk up to a door and press E. The street is put away and the building's own interior is built. When you leave through the glowing door inside, the street is rebuilt and you are standing where you were, facing away from the door. Doors are not offered in co-op.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 在开放城市里，每栋建筑都有一扇门：朝向街道一侧的发光门框，共 1,133 扇（996 栋普通建筑，加上 137 处有实心占地的地标）。门框的颜色由门后是什么决定，所以从街对面就能分清面馆和诊所。走到门前按 E。街道会被收起，这栋建筑自己的内部随即建成。当你从室内那扇发光的门离开时，街道会重新建起，你站在原来的位置，背对着那扇门。合作模式中不提供门。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What is behind them
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 门后是什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A building is the same place every time you enter it. What it is depends on its district and its size: apartments and noodle bars where the heights and the hive crowd together, clinics and clubs in the Memory District, offices and server rooms under Helix, warehouses and workshops along the harbour and the rail yards. The named landmarks keep their names, and a hall, a cathedral, a vault, a dome, a factory or a clinic is laid out as one. The inside is always bigger than the outside: between seven and seventeen four-metre cells wide, with up to four rooms joined by doorways, and every cell of the floor can be reached from the door.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 同一栋建筑，每次进入都是同一个地方。它是什么，取决于所在街区和大小：在高地和蜂巢，公寓和面馆挤在一起；在记忆区是诊所和夜店；在螺旋之下是办公室和服务器机房；沿着港口和铁路场则是仓库和工坊。有名字的地标保留自己的名字，大厅、大教堂、金库、穹顶、工厂和诊所都会按各自的样子布置。里面总比外面大：宽七到十七个四米见方的格子，最多四个房间，用门洞相连，地板上的每一格都能从门口走到。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: No two are alike. Each type has three layouts, and each building tints its type's colours a little. Shops, bars, noodle bars, clinics and halls have a counter with someone behind it. There are 22 kinds of furniture, from hospital beds with their monitors and vending machines to DJ decks, cubicles, workbenches, pews, boilers and cookers. Every room has its own floor, from checkered tile and carpet to dance-floor panels, raised server floor and a red aisle through stone. The name of the place is on the wall, and some have windows onto the night city. Overhead there are paper lanterns, pipes and turning fans, a mirror ball and beams in a club, blinking lights in a server room, and a ring of candles in a hall.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 没有两处是一样的。每种类型有三种布局，每栋建筑还会把该类型的颜色微调一点。商店、酒吧、面馆、诊所和大厅都有柜台，柜台后站着人。家具共有 22 种，从带监护仪的病床和自动贩卖机，到 DJ 台、隔间办公桌、工作台、长椅、锅炉和灶台。每个房间都有自己的地面，从方格瓷砖和地毯，到舞池彩格、架空的服务器地板，以及石砖中间的一条红毯。墙上挂着这个地方的名字，有些还开着朝向夜景的窗户。头顶有纸灯笼、管道和转动的风扇，夜店里有镜面球和光束，服务器机房里灯光闪烁，大厅里悬着一圈烛光。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What you find
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你会找到什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: There are people to talk to, one to three in each building, and they each have a few things to say. There are one or two stashes, and a stash is searched once per save: it pays between 20 and 90 credits, plus a quarter more for each act you have reached. Nobody inside is hostile, and you cannot be hunted there; the way out is always the door you came in by.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 每栋建筑里有一到三个可以交谈的人，他们各自有几句话要说。还有一两处藏匿处，每个存档里每处只能搜一次：能给 20 到 90 点信用点，每到一幕再多四分之一。里面没有人怀有敌意，你也不会在那里被追捕；出路永远是你进来的那扇门。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Black markets
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 黑市

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The pause menu no longer sells anything. The Black Market is hidden in the alleys: ten stalls stand in the middle of the narrow passages between buildings, out of sight of both streets, each under a tarp with a dim neon sign and a dealer behind the counter. They are not on the street and they are not marked in the world, and the nearest is a long walk from where you start. The minimap points the way: a pink diamond where a stall is on the map, and pink arrows on its edge pointing to the nearest three that are not. Press E at the counter to open the whole arsenal. There is no market during an operation, so buy before you go: weapons, ammunition, consumables and upgrades all come from a stall. The same stalls stand in co-op.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 暂停菜单不再出售任何东西。黑市藏在小巷里：十个摊位设在建筑之间窄巷的中段，两头的街道都看不到，每个都有篷布、暗淡的霓虹招牌和柜台后的商贩。它们不在街边，世界里也没有标记，最近的一个离你的出生点也要走很远。小地图会给你指路：摊位在地图范围内时是一个粉色菱形，不在范围内时，地图边缘会有粉色箭头指向最近的三个。在柜台前按 E 即可打开整个军火库。行动中没有黑市，所以出发前就要买好：武器、弹药、消耗品和升级都从摊位购买。合作模式中也有同样的摊位。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: THE CYBERDECK: RAM, HEX GRIDS AND A COMMAND PROMPT
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 赛博甲板：内存、十六进制网格与命令提示符

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: What the deck is
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 甲板是什么

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Ghost's deck is the part of the implant that does the hacking. It has a bank of RAM, shown on the HUD as violet pips under the dash energy, and every hack spends some of it. RAM is full at the start of every level and trickles back while you play. The deck is switched off in story scenes and in the apartment.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 幽灵的甲板是植入体里负责黑入的部分。它有一组内存，在 HUD 上显示为冲刺能量下方的紫色小格，每次黑入都会消耗一部分。每个关卡开始时内存是满的，游戏过程中会慢慢恢复。剧情场景和公寓里甲板是关闭的。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Three things spend RAM. A terminal hack costs 2 for ICE BREAK, 2 for HEX SEQUENCE and 3 for COMMAND PROMPT. A cyberattack from the hotbar costs 3 for the sensor cloak, 2 for the firewall, 2 for the reveal, 4 for turn, 4 for overload, 2 for blind, 3 for gravity, 3 for chain and 1 for anything else. And PING, on Z (a touch button on phones), costs 1 and marks every hostile in range for 8 seconds. Without enough RAM you get a warning and nothing happens, and a cyberattack that finds no target costs nothing. Walk away from a terminal before you have entered anything and the RAM comes back. Neural Coolant refills the whole bank, and makes every hack and cyberattack 25% cheaper (rounded up) for twelve seconds.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 有三样东西会消耗内存。黑入终端：破冰入侵 2 点，十六进制序列 2 点，命令提示符 3 点。快捷栏上的网络攻击：传感器隐身 3 点，防火墙 2 点，揭示 2 点，策反 4 点，过载 4 点，致盲 2 点，重力 3 点，连锁 3 点，其余 1 点。还有 Z 键的探测（手机上是触控按钮），消耗 1 点，把范围内所有敌人标记 8 秒。内存不够时会提示警告，什么也不会发生；找不到目标的网络攻击不消耗内存。在还没输入任何内容之前离开终端，内存会退还给你。神经冷却剂会把整组内存补满，并让每次黑入和网络攻击便宜 25%（向上取整），持续十二秒。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Three ways in
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 三种入侵方式

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Every terminal is one of three games, fixed by the level, so a terminal is always the same game. In Act 1 it is 55% ICE BREAK, 30% HEX SEQUENCE and 15% COMMAND PROMPT. In Act 2 it is 40, 35 and 25. From Act 3 on it is about a third each. Override pylons on boss levels are always ICE BREAK, and so is everything in Cardboard.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 每个终端是三种小游戏之一，由关卡决定，所以同一个终端永远是同一种游戏。第一幕中破冰入侵占 55%，十六进制序列占 30%，命令提示符占 15%；第二幕是 40、35、25；从第三幕起各占大约三分之一。头目关卡的覆盖信号塔永远是破冰入侵，在 Cardboard 模式下一切也都是破冰入侵。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: ICE BREAK is the code matrix from the first chapters: walk the lit row and column and upload the sequence before the trace finishes. HEX SEQUENCE is a grid of two-digit hex codes, 4 by 4 (5 by 5 from Act 3). A row above it shows the codes to enter, as many as the terminal's length plus two. Click them in that order, or move with the arrow keys or the d-pad and press Enter. The trace lasts the larger of 9 and 17 minus the act number, plus 1.7 seconds for every code, scaled by your trace multiplier. A wrong code costs 2.2 seconds and counts as a mistake. Three mistakes, or four with a Buffer Extender, burn the session: it makes noise within 16 m (unless you run Ghost Protocol) and the grid shuffles again.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 破冰入侵就是前几章的代码矩阵：沿着亮起的行和列移动，在追踪完成前上传序列。十六进制序列是一张两位十六进制代码的网格，4 乘 4（从第三幕起 5 乘 5）。网格上方一行显示要输入的代码，数量是终端长度加二。按这个顺序点击它们，或用方向键或方向键盘移动并按回车。追踪时间是 9 与 17 减去幕数这两者中较大的一个，再加每个代码 1.7 秒，并按你的追踪倍率缩放。输错一个代码会损失 2.2 秒，并算作一次失误。三次失误（装了缓冲扩展器则是四次）会烧毁这次会话：它会在 16 米内制造噪音（除非你运行幽灵协议），网格重新洗牌。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: COMMAND PROMPT is a shell on someone else's machine. It understands help, ls, cat, scan, login, knock, open, decrypt, hint and exit. Tab completes a file name, the up arrow repeats a command, and clicking a file name reads it. Each machine is one of three puzzles at random. On a gateway you log in as the administrator, whose name is in one file and whose password is the pet's name followed by the year of hire, spelled out in two others. On a firewalled host you knock three ports in order and then run open. On a vault you glue two key fragments together in the order a note gives and decrypt. Three wrong attempts, or four with a Buffer Extender, burn the session, and so does the trace running out: the larger of 55 and 100 minus 6 for every act, in seconds, scaled by your trace multiplier. Typing hint gives a clearer clue each time and takes 12 seconds off the trace.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 命令提示符是别人机器上的一个命令行。它能理解 help、ls、cat、scan、login、knock、open、decrypt、hint 和 exit。Tab 会补全文件名，上方向键重复上一条命令，点击文件名就会读取它。每台机器随机是三种谜题之一。在网关上，你要以管理员身份登录：用户名在一个文件里，密码是宠物名加入职年份，写在另外两个文件里。在有防火墙的主机上，你要按顺序敲击三个端口，再运行 open。在保险库里，你要把两段密钥片段按便条给出的顺序拼起来，然后解密。三次错误尝试（装了缓冲扩展器则是四次）会烧毁会话，追踪时间耗尽也一样：秒数是 55 与 100 减去每幕 6 秒这两者中较大的一个，再按你的追踪倍率缩放。输入 hint 每次会给出更明确的线索，并扣掉 12 秒追踪时间。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Upgrading the deck
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 升级甲板

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The deck has five marks, bought at any Black Market stall in the new Cyberdeck tab. Mark I has 6 RAM, recovers 1 every 14 seconds and has 1 mod slot. Mark II has 8, 1 every 11 seconds, 2 slots, and costs 900 credits and 6 Parts. Mark III has 10, 1 every 9 seconds, 2 slots, and costs 2,200 credits, 12 Parts and 1 Military Component. Mark IV has 12, 1 every 7 seconds, 3 slots, and costs 5,000 credits, 20 Parts and 3 Military Components. Mark V has 15, 1 every 5 seconds, 4 slots, and costs 11,000 credits, 30 Parts, 6 Military Components and 1 Quantum Fragment.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 甲板共有五个型号，在任何一个黑市摊位的新“赛博甲板”分页里购买。一型有 6 点内存，每 14 秒恢复 1 点，有 1 个改装槽。二型有 8 点，每 11 秒 1 点，2 个槽，花费 900 信用点和 6 个零件。三型有 10 点，每 9 秒 1 点，2 个槽，花费 2,200 信用点、12 个零件和 1 个军用部件。四型有 12 点，每 7 秒 1 点，3 个槽，花费 5,000 信用点、20 个零件和 3 个军用部件。五型有 15 点，每 5 秒 1 点，4 个槽，花费 11,000 信用点、30 个零件、6 个军用部件和 1 块量子碎片。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Mods are bought in the same tab, one time each, and equipped into the slots. A new mod goes straight into a free slot, and you can swap them freely at any stall. The deck is part of your save and travels with you into free roam.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 改装件也在同一分页购买，每种只买一次，再装进槽位。新买的改装件会直接装进空槽，你可以在任何摊位随意更换。甲板是存档的一部分，并且会随你进入自由漫游。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The nine mods
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 九种改装

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Overclock Rig (700 credits, 6 Parts) makes RAM recover 60% faster. Cryo Coolant (900 credits, 6 Parts) doubles recovery while you crouch, and the two stack. Recursion (2,400 credits, 12 Parts, 2 Military Components) gives 2 RAM back for every terminal you hack. It does not work on boss pylons.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 超频装置（700 信用点、6 个零件）让内存恢复快 60%。低温冷却剂（900 信用点、6 个零件）让蹲下时的恢复速度翻倍，两者可以叠加。递归（2,400 信用点、12 个零件、2 个军用部件）每黑入一个终端就返还 2 点内存，对头目信号塔无效。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Buffer Extender (600 credits, 5 Parts) allows one more mistake in HEX SEQUENCE and COMMAND PROMPT, and two more codes in the ICE BREAK buffer. Ice Pick (1,800 credits, 10 Parts, 1 Military Component) takes 1 off every RAM cost, never below 1. Datamine (800 credits, 4 Parts) pays credits for every terminal you hack, 18 plus 12 for every act (1.5 times that for COMMAND PROMPT), and a quarter of the time two Parts as well.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 缓冲扩展器（600 信用点、5 个零件）让十六进制序列和命令提示符多容许一次失误，并让破冰入侵的缓冲区多两个代码。冰锥（1,800 信用点、10 个零件、1 个军用部件）让每次内存消耗减 1，最低为 1。数据挖掘（800 信用点、4 个零件）每黑入一个终端就付给信用点，数额是 18 加每幕 12 点，命令提示符则是它的 1.5 倍，四分之一的几率还会多给两个零件。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Ghost Protocol (1,500 credits, 8 Parts, 1 Military Component) makes failed hacks silent, and cyberattacks leave no sound at the target. Echo Chamber (1,200 credits, 8 Parts) makes a single-target cyberattack hit the nearest other hostile within 8 m too, and area attacks reach 4 m further. Helix Spoofer (1,400 credits, 8 Parts, 1 Military Component) makes the Helix trace on your Nuallink climb 40% slower.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 幽灵协议（1,500 信用点、8 个零件、1 个军用部件）让失败的黑入悄无声息，网络攻击也不会在目标处留下声响。回声腔（1,200 信用点、8 个零件）让单体网络攻击同时命中 8 米内最近的另一名敌人，范围攻击则延伸 4 米。Helix 欺骗器（1,400 信用点、8 个零件、1 个军用部件）让你 Nuallink 上的 Helix 追踪攀升速度慢 40%。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: SILENT WORK: CHOKEHOLDS, KNOCKOUTS AND BODIES
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 无声行动：锁喉、击晕与尸体

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The chokehold
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 锁喉

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Get behind a guard who has not noticed you (within 2.4 m, not alerted, and either in the arc behind them or still unsuspicious, under 30 percent) and hold E. On a pad hold X, on a phone hold USE. A guard who is stunned can be taken from any side, and a shield trooper only from behind or while stunned. You cannot move or shoot while you hold, and the HUD shows a bar with a marker at the point where the grab lands.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 绕到一名还没发现你的守卫身后（距离在 2.4 米内、未处于警戒状态，并且要么在他们身后的范围内，要么他们仍未起疑，怀疑度低于 30%），然后按住 E。手柄按住 X，手机按住“使用”键。被眩晕的守卫可以从任何方向下手，盾牌士兵只能从背后或在眩晕时下手。按住期间你不能移动或开火，HUD 会显示一条进度条，上面有一个标记，指示擒抱生效的位置。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Let go before 0.6 seconds and the guard slips free, suspicious but not alerted. Let go later and they go out cold. How long they stay down depends on how long you held: about 6 seconds at the grab, 12 at one second, 35 at two, 61 at three and 87 at the end of the bar, with a ceiling of 90. Hold to the end of the bar, 4 seconds, and the guard dies. The last fifth of the bar is red as a warning. Heavy troopers take 1.4 times as long, 5.6 seconds. Story targets, such as an assassin's mark or an officer carrying a keycard, can only be killed, take 3.2 seconds and slip free if you let go early. If anything hurts you while you hold, the guard tears loose and raises the alarm.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 在 0.6 秒前松手，守卫会挣脱，起疑但不会进入警戒。之后松手，他们会昏迷。昏迷多久取决于你按了多久：擒抱瞬间约 6 秒，一秒时 12 秒，两秒时 35 秒，三秒时 61 秒，进度条末端 87 秒，上限为 90 秒。一直按到进度条末端，也就是 4 秒，守卫就会死亡。进度条的最后五分之一是红色，作为警告。重装士兵需要 1.4 倍的时间，即 5.6 秒。剧情目标，比如刺客的目标或持有门禁卡的军官，只能被杀死，需要 3.2 秒，提前松手他们就会挣脱。如果你在按住期间受到伤害，守卫会挣脱并拉响警报。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Co-op, arena and defence modes keep the old instant takedown. Weapons that are nonlethal knock out too: a stun round that would have killed leaves the target down for 30 seconds, and a stun blade on an unaware guard for 45.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 合作、竞技场和防守模式保留旧的瞬间击倒。非致命武器同样会击晕：本来会致死的电击弹让目标倒下 30 秒，对毫无察觉的守卫使用电击刃则是 45 秒。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Waking and tying
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 苏醒与捆绑

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A knocked-out guard wakes when the timer runs out. They wake searching for 8 seconds and with at least half their health, and they say so. Zip-tie them (press E on the body, 2 seconds) and they stay down for the rest of the level. A guard is paid for, and looted, only the first time they go down: 14 credits times your credit multiplier, plus the usual drop. Tying also searches the body.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 被击晕的守卫在计时结束时苏醒。他们苏醒后会搜索 8 秒，生命值至少恢复到一半，并且会喊出来。给他们戴上扎带（对着身体按 E，耗时 2 秒），他们就会在本关剩余时间里保持倒下。守卫只有第一次倒下时才会付钱并被搜刮：14 信用点乘以你的信用点倍率，外加通常的掉落。捆绑也会同时搜身。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Searching, carrying and hiding
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 搜身、搬运与藏匿

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Searching a body, which tying and picking up both do, pays 10 credits plus 4 for every act plus up to 10 more, times your credit multiplier. More than a third of the time, 35 percent, it also finds an item: 15 percent a Noisemaker, 11 percent a Trauma Patch, 9 percent a grenade. A body pays once.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 搜身（捆绑和背起时都会搜身）会得到 10 信用点，加上每一幕 4 点，再加最多 10 点，再乘以你的信用点倍率。有超过三分之一的几率，35%，还会找到一件物品：15% 是噪音装置，11% 是创伤贴片，9% 是手雷。每具身体只能搜一次。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Press E on a dead or tied body to pick it up. You carry it at 60 percent of your speed, you cannot sprint, shoot or use weapons, and E drops it. To get it out of sight, put it in a waste bin, the green bins that stand against walls in open floor (4 in a mission, up to 36 across the city), or behind any cover between 0.35 and 1.5 metres tall: crates and furniture. Market stalls do not count. A guard who is only knocked out will wake inside the bin and climb out, so tie them first.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 对着死亡或已捆绑的身体按 E 可以把它背起来。你背着它时速度只有平时的 60%，不能冲刺、开火或使用武器，按 E 放下。要把它藏起来，就放进垃圾箱，也就是靠着墙立在开阔地面上的绿色垃圾箱（每个任务 4 个，整座城市最多 36 个），或者任何 0.35 到 1.5 米高的掩体：板条箱和家具。市场摊位不算。只是被击晕的守卫会在垃圾箱里醒来并爬出来，所以先把他们捆起来。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Bodies are found
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 尸体会被发现

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Every third of a second, every guard who is on patrol, suspicious or searching checks for bodies in plain sight: within 12 metres, within about 57 degrees of where they face, or within 3 metres in any direction, with a clear line. A blackout cuts the range. A body you are carrying counts. The guard who finds one goes to look, and patrols within 10 metres join in. When the guard reaches the body they raise the alarm, and if the body was knocked out and not tied they wake it. Guards who die while hunting you count as already known, and arena and defence modes do not use any of this.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 每隔三分之一秒，每个正在巡逻、起疑或搜索的守卫都会检查视野内的尸体：距离在 12 米内，位于他们面朝方向约 57 度的范围内，或者在 3 米内的任何方向，并且视线畅通。停电会缩短距离。你背着的尸体也算。发现尸体的守卫会过去查看，10 米内的巡逻守卫也会加入。守卫走到尸体旁时会拉响警报，如果那是被击晕且未捆绑的身体，他们还会把它弄醒。在追捕你时死亡的守卫视为已经被发现，竞技场和防守模式不使用这一切。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Making noise
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 制造声响

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: T whistles: every patrolling or suspicious guard within 12 metres comes to where you stand. It has a 3 second cooldown. A Noisemaker, a quick-slot item that costs 80 credits, carries 5 and you start with 2, clatters where you aim, up to 16 metres away or the first wall, and pulls in every patrolling or suspicious guard within 22 metres. Wait behind a corner and the guard who comes to look hands you a chokehold.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 按 T 吹口哨：12 米内每个正在巡逻或起疑的守卫都会来到你站的地方。冷却时间 3 秒。噪音装置是快捷栏物品，售价 80 信用点，最多携带 5 个，开局送你 2 个，它会落在你瞄准的地方发出响动，最远 16 米或到第一堵墙为止，并吸引 22 米内每个正在巡逻或起疑的守卫。躲在拐角后面，前来查看的守卫就会把脖子送到你手里。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: TOOLS OF THE TRADE: CAMERAS, BREAKERS, LOCKS AND IMPLANTS
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 行业工具：摄像头、断路器、锁与植入体

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Cameras and breaker boxes
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 摄像头与断路器箱

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Operations (not tutorials, arenas, boss fights or the open city) now hang security cameras on the walls: 2 in Act 1, 3 in Acts 2 and 3, 4 from Act 4. They prefer a spot with a clear line to a terminal or the exit, and they show on your minimap as orange dots. A camera sweeps back and forth across 0.9 radians either side of where it points and sees a cone about 29 degrees to each side of its lens, 15 metres out (70 percent of that while you crouch, less in a blackout). A Black Sun cloak blinds it. You are safe while you stay out of the cone, behind cover or out of range.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 行动关卡（教程、竞技场、头目战和开放城市除外）现在会在墙上装安防摄像头：第一幕 2 个，第二、三幕 3 个，第四幕起 4 个。它们倾向于选在能直视终端或出口的位置，并在你的小地图上显示为橙色圆点。摄像头会在朝向两侧各 0.9 弧度范围内来回扫动，视野是镜头两侧各约 29 度的锥形，距离 15 米（你蹲下时为 70%，停电时更短）。黑日隐身会让它失明。只要你待在锥形范围外、掩体后或射程外，就是安全的。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: A camera that keeps you in its cone for 1.1 seconds, a little less if your detection multiplier is high, sets off an alarm. Every guard within 32 metres who is not already hunting you or holding a post goes to where you are standing, your Helix trace rises by 20 and the alert counts against your score. The camera then needs 10 seconds before it can call again. One shot from any gun destroys a camera for good, with a bang that carries 10 metres.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 摄像头把你保持在视野内达到 1.1 秒（如果你的探测倍率高，则略短）就会拉响警报。每个距离 32 米内、还没有在追捕你或守着岗位的守卫都会赶往你站立的位置，你的螺旋追踪上升 20 点，这次警报会计入你的评分。之后摄像头需要 10 秒才能再次呼叫。任何枪支的一枪就能彻底摧毁摄像头，爆响会传到 10 米外。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Each pair of cameras comes with a breaker box on a wall, found on the minimap as a yellow dot. Press E and throw the breaker, 1.2 seconds. Every camera goes dark for 45 seconds, and for 25 seconds every guard sees only 60 percent as far. The throw is loud for 8 metres, and the box takes 90 seconds to recharge.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 每两个摄像头配有一个墙上的断路器箱，在小地图上是黄色圆点。按 E 拉下闸刀，需要 1.2 秒。所有摄像头会黑掉 45 秒，在 25 秒内每个守卫只能看到平时 60% 的距离。拉闸的声音在 8 米内很响，断路器箱需要 90 秒才能恢复。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Locks
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 锁

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Every operation has a locked cache, two from Act 2, and two stashes in every five inside buildings are locked. Press E to open the lockpick game: a needle sweeps round a dial, and you set each pin by pressing E, Enter, or clicking the dial while the needle is inside the green arc. There are 3 pins, 4 from Act 4. The first arc is 0.5 radians either side of its centre and each pin narrows it by 0.07 down to a floor of 0.26, while the needle starts at 2 radians a second and gains 0.6 for every pin. A miss snaps a pick and costs you one; if you run out the lock jams and you walk away with your picks gone and your cache shut.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 每次行动都有一个上锁的储物箱，第二幕起有两个，建筑内每五处藏匿点有两处是上锁的。按 E 进入开锁小游戏：一根指针绕着表盘扫动，当指针位于绿色弧段内时，按 E、回车或点击表盘来定位每个锁销。共有 3 个锁销，第四幕起 4 个。第一段弧在中心两侧各 0.5 弧度，每定位一个锁销就收窄 0.07，最低 0.26，而指针起始速度为每秒 2 弧度，每多一个锁销加快 0.6。失手会折断一支开锁器，你就损失一支；用完后锁会卡死，你带着用光的开锁器和仍然关着的储物箱离开。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: You begin with 3 lockpicks. The workbench makes 2 for 2 Parts, or sells 1 for 45 credits. An opened cache pays 60 credits plus 25 for every act plus up to 60 more, times your credit multiplier, 3 to 5 Parts, a Military Component one time in five, and a consumable (grenade, Trauma Patch, EMP, Noisemaker, Exploit Shard or Neural Coolant) more than half the time. A locked stash pays 2.2 times what an open one does.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 你一开始有 3 支开锁器。工作台用 2 个零件制作 2 支，或者花 45 信用点买 1 支。打开的储物箱会支付 60 信用点，加每一幕 25 点，再加最多 60 点，乘以你的信用点倍率，还有 3 到 5 个零件，五分之一的几率有一个军用部件，以及超过一半的几率有一件消耗品（手雷、创伤贴片、EMP、噪音装置、漏洞碎片或神经冷却剂）。上锁的藏匿点支付的数额是未上锁的 2.2 倍。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Cyberware
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 义体植入

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: Three implants can be active at once, bought and equipped in the Cyberware tab of any Black Market stall. The Reflex Booster (3,000 credits, 10 Parts, 3 Military Components) slows the world to 30 percent for 4 seconds when you press B, LB with RB on a pad or the SLOW button on a phone. It costs 45 energy and has a 14 second cooldown. You, your energy and your timers keep their own speed, so you can walk a gun's length past a guard who is hardly moving. Subdermal Plating (1,800 credits, 10 Parts) takes 12 percent off all damage. Tendon Boosters (1,200 credits, 8 Parts) make you 8 percent faster. The Cyberoptic Scanner (1,500 credits, 6 Parts, 1 Military Component) marks hostiles within 12 metres through walls. Nanite Repair (2,200 credits, 12 Parts, 2 Military Components) heals you 1.5 a second while you are below half health and have been unhurt for 4 seconds. Silent Steps (1,000 credits, 6 Parts) stops your sprint making noise and makes you 15 percent faster while crouched.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 可以同时启用三件植入体，在任何黑市摊位的“义体”分页购买并装备。反射增强器（3,000 信用点、10 个零件、3 个军用部件）在你按 B 键（手柄上是 LB 加 RB，手机上是“慢动作”按钮）时，把世界减速到 30%，持续 4 秒。它消耗 45 点能量，冷却 14 秒。你自己、你的能量和你的计时器保持原来的速度，所以你可以从几乎不动的守卫身边走过，近在咫尺。皮下装甲（1,800 信用点、10 个零件）让所有伤害减少 12%。腱肌增强器（1,200 信用点、8 个零件）让你快 8%。义眼扫描仪（1,500 信用点、6 个零件、1 个军用部件）会透过墙壁标记 12 米内的敌人。纳米修复（2,200 信用点、12 个零件、2 个军用部件）在你生命值低于一半且已经 4 秒没有受伤时，每秒为你恢复 1.5 点。无声步伐（1,000 信用点、6 个零件）让你冲刺时不再发出声响，蹲行时快 15%。

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The workbench
序言：为什么会有这份文件: 工作台

PREFACE: WHY THIS DOCUMENT EXISTS: The Crafting tab turns Weapon Parts into tools. Lockpicks come 2 for 2 Parts or 1 for 45 credits. A Noisemaker costs 3 Parts, a Trauma Patch 4, a fragmentation grenade 5 and an Exploit Shard 3. An EMP grenade takes 6 Parts and 1 Military Component, and a Neural Coolant 8 Parts and 1 Military Component. Nothing can be crafted past the amount you can carry.
序言：为什么会有这份文件: “制作”分页把武器零件变成工具。开锁器 2 个零件做 2 支，或花 45 信用点买 1 支。噪音装置需要 3 个零件，创伤贴片 4 个，破片手雷 5 个，漏洞碎片 3 个。EMP 手雷需要 6 个零件和 1 个军用部件，神经冷却剂需要 8 个零件和 1 个军用部件。制作的东西不能超过你能携带的数量。
